jobs.title: Project & Business Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands\-on **Project \& Business Operations Generalist** to work directly with the CEO and help drive a wide range of business initiatives and projects from concept through execution. ***This position requires Japanese \& English Bilingals.***

This is a cross\-functional role that is not limited to one department or area of responsibility. The successful candidate will work across multiple businesses and brands operated by us, supporting areas such as **E\-Commerce, retail operations, import and logistics, product development, sales and marketing, and new project initiatives**.

This is not a strategy\-only or desk\-based position. We are looking for someone who can understand the CEO’s ideas and business objectives, translate them into clear action plans, organize priorities and timelines, and then personally help execute the work necessary to move each project forward.

The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, organized, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment where responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Work directly with the CEO to translate business ideas, priorities, and initiatives into actionable plans
* Coordinate and execute multiple projects simultaneously from planning through completion
* Develop project timelines, organize tasks and priorities, track progress, and follow up on deliverables
* Support the launch and implementation of new project initiatives, products, and projects
* Handle day\-to\-day operational tasks related to the company’s imported goods business
* Support product planning, sourcing, purchasing, importation, logistics, and sales activities
* Provide cross\-functional operational support across our businesses and brands
* Support the operation and growth of the company’s E\-Commerce business
* Assist with Shopify and other E\-Commerce platform\-related operations
* Develop and execute initiatives that connect physical retail locations with the company’s E\-Commerce platform
* Help convert in\-store customers into repeat online and E\-Commerce customers
* Provide hands\-on support at retail locations, including customer service, sales, promotions, events, and other operational needs when necessary
* Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, logistics providers, business partners, and store staff
* Support marketing, social media, promotional, and customer acquisition initiatives
* Identify operational issues and recommend practical solutions
* Provide regular project updates, progress reports, and recommendations to the CEO

**Required Qualifications:**

* Professional working proficiency in both **English and Japanese**
* Legally authorized to work in the United States (OPT acceptable)
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work independently and take initiative without requiring detailed step\-by\-step direction
* Strong follow\-through and ability to complete projects within established timelines
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable working both in an office environment and at retail/store locations as needed
* Proficiency with standard business and computer applications
* Willingness to take on a broad range of responsibilities based on changing business needs

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is proactive, resourceful, and action\-oriented
* Can turn ideas and high\-level direction into concrete action plans
* Enjoys building projects and processes from the ground up
* Takes ownership of projects and follows them through to completion
* Does not limit themselves strictly to a predefined job description
* Identifies problems and proactively proposes solutions
* Works with a strong sense of urgency while maintaining organization and attention to detail
* Is equally comfortable planning a project and personally executing the necessary tasks
* Enjoys working across multiple businesses, brands, and functions
* Can shift comfortably between larger projects and detailed day\-to\-day operational tasks
* Thrives in an entrepreneurial and fast\-changing environment

**Preferred Experience \& Skills:**

Experience in all of the following areas is **not required**. We value candidates who demonstrate strong generalist capabilities and experience across several functional areas.

**Preferred experience includes:**

* Project Management / Project Coordination
* Business Operations
* Retail / Store Operations
* E\-Commerce
* Shopify or similar E\-Commerce platforms
* Import / Logistics / Supply Chain
* Marketing / Social Media / Digital Marketing
* Product Planning / Product Development
* Sales / Business Development
* Vendor Management
* New project, product, or retail location launches

**What We Value Most:**

This position is designed for an **execution\-oriented generalist**, rather than a specialist focused exclusively on one functional area.

The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, move between different business functions, and take ownership of getting projects completed.

This is a **hands\-on role**. Depending on the project, you may be managing a timeline in the morning, communicating with a vendor or logistics partner, updating an E\-Commerce operation, supporting a marketing initiative, visiting a retail location, or assisting with customer\-facing sales activities.

We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable both **thinking and doing**.

When evaluating candidates, we place particular emphasis on:

**Initiative**  Execution **Adaptability**  Problem\-Solving **Organization**  Ownership **Project Management**

Experience in a specific industry is valuable, but the ability to **learn quickly, take ownership, and turn ideas into results** is more important.

**Employment Details:**

* **Position:** Project \& Business Operations Generalist – CEO Off

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About XLI**
At XLI, we build more than just structures. We build careers, relationships, and the future. As a purpose\-driven general contractor, our culture is grounded in servant leadership, accountability, and collaboration. Our Assistant Project Managers are integral to driving success across our projects and shaping the future of construction.  

**Position Summary**
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of construction projects. In partnership with the Project Manager and Superintendent, the APM oversees documentation, procurement, budgeting, schedule adherence, and quality control. This role is ideal for a dynamic builder with strong attention to detail, leadership capabilities, and a passion for continuous learning.  

**Key Responsibilities*** Review contracts, assess risk, and communicate key areas of exposure to the project team.
* Lead the bid process by developing detailed instructions to bidders, ensuring scope coverage, accuracy, and appropriate risk mitigation.
* Support subcontractor buyout and selection processes, including subcontract execution and issue resolution.
* Assemble and manage the project control estimate.
* Manage all aspects of construction management, including:
* Preconstruction
* Scheduling
* Procurement
* Submittals
* RFIs
* Change orders
* Budgeting
* Forecasting
* Billing
* Project closeout
* Ensure project permits, inspections, and tests are accurately identified and scheduled.
* Own the project procurement plan and procurement log, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
* Foster effective relationships with clients and design teams through consistent communication and leadership during Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC) meetings and site walks.
* Maintain document control accuracy and timeliness.
* Leverage internal resources including VDC, Lean practices, SPW, XL Shop, and other tools to drive project and team effectiveness.
* Train and mentor Project Engineers, Project Administrators, and Project Accountants.
* Promote and model XLI's core values, safety culture, and operational excellence.

 **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of construction experience, preferably as a Senior Project Engineer or Assistant Project Manager.
* Experience working on healthcare, education, life sciences, civic, or commercial office projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing or assisting with small projects.
* Proficiency with:
* Microsoft Office
* Procore
* Primavera P6
* Timberline
* Vista
* Solid understanding of:
* MEP trades
* Scheduling
* Permit processes
* OSHA 10 Certification.
* Ability to build trust across project stakeholders and internal teams.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

 **Core Competencies*** XLI Stewardship
* Managerial Courage
* Bridge Builder
* People Developer
* Continuous Learner
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Edge

 **Compensation**
In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Laws (SB 1162\), XLI is committed to fair and equitable compensation.* Base Salary Range: $120,000 – $135,000 annually
* Eligible for annual performance bonus program
* Eligible for vehicle reimbursement


Compensation will be determined based on experience, education, qualifications, and internal equity.  

**Why Join XLI?**
At XLI, we offer more than a job. We offer a purpose. From career development to mentorship and a people\-first culture, we are proud to support your growth in construction leadership.  

**Benefits Include*** Competitive salary and annual bonus program
* Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Monthly vehicle reimbursement
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Opportunities to work on meaningful, high\-impact projects

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Life Sciences & Labratory Planning
jobs.description:
**About Visions**



Founded in 2007, Visions Management set out to reimagine the client experience with move management, space planning \& FFE services. Since then, we’ve built a diverse team of experts united by creativity, adaptability, and a passion for delivering seamless solutions.



Over the years, our services have expanded to include embedded workplace services alongside our relocation and project management offerings, allowing us to partner more deeply with clients and support them in creating workplaces that are efficient, resilient and people\-focused.



Recognized for our growth and workplace culture, we are proud to be a 3x Inc. 5000 honoree, named among the North Bay Business Journal’s Best Places to Work, recognized by the San Francisco Business Times as one of the Fastest Growing Companies, and the recipient of an EcoVadis Silver Medal for our commitment to sustainability, ethical business practices, and social responsibility.



At Visions, diversity isn’t just a value but a driver of innovation and impact. We believe unique perspectives strengthen our team and allow us to better serve our clients. As a family\-first company, we foster a culture of growth, education, and collaboration, inspiring our people to learn, lead and bring big ideas to life.



We are excited to learn more about you.  

  

**About the Team**



The Life Sciences team provides specialized relocation services to clients in the Bio\-Tech, Pharma, Education and Healthcare industries. Our decades of experience with projects in clinical and research environments are critical to support our clients with complex, detailed, and specialized projects. We are proud ambassadors of Visions Management and embrace our role representing Visions’ commitment to our client first approach.

 **About the Role**

 **Responsibilities –**

  

The **Senior Project Manager, Life Sciences \& Laboratory Planning** leads complex laboratory relocation, infrastructure, and planning projects across research, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, and academic environments.



This role combines strong project leadership with deep knowledge of laboratory operations, scientific equipment, infrastructure, and space planning. You will serve as a primary client contact while also acting as a technical resource to clients and project teams throughout planning, design, relocation, installation, commissioning, and operational readiness.

  

You’ll work closely with scientists, laboratory managers, facilities teams, architects, engineers, contractors, equipment manufacturers, and specialty vendors to translate scientific and operational requirements into practical project solutions. From developing schedules and budgets to reviewing equipment layouts, utilities, fit\-up requirements, and relocation sequencing, you will help ensure projects are technically sound, operationally successful, and delivered with minimal disruption to research.

  



Project \& Client Leadership

  

* Lead complex laboratory relocation, planning, and infrastructure projects from early planning through execution and closeout.
* Serve as a primary client contact and trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, forecasts, risk plans, and key deliverables.
* Lead project meetings and coordinate scientists, laboratory managers, facilities teams, architects, engineers, contractors, and specialty vendors.
* Manage vendor scopes, change orders, project documentation, and reporting.
* Deliver projects on time, on budget, and in alignment with client expectations and defined project KPI’s.

  



Laboratory Equipment \& Space Planning

  

* Lead laboratory equipment planning for relocations, renovations, new construction, and facility improvement projects.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive equipment inventories, databases, layouts, and planning documentation.
* Partner with scientists, principal investigators, laboratory managers, and facilities stakeholders to understand equipment and operational requirements.
* Evaluate equipment for reuse, replacement, relocation, or disposition.
* Identify equipment requirements including electrical, plumbing, gases, exhaust, HVAC, chilled water, DI water, compressed air, vacuum, and specialty utilities.
* Coordinate equipment dimensions, weights, service clearances, structural requirements, access paths, and installation sequencing.

  



Design, Technical Coordination \& Documentation

  

* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and laboratory design documents to ensure equipment compatibility and coordination.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, contractors, and specialty consultants to integrate laboratory equipment and infrastructure requirements into the overall design.
* Review utility rough\-ins, structural support requirements, equipment clearances, access paths, and installation feasibility.

jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

**Logistical Details**

**Part\-Time**: This position will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow to 20\+ hours per week as the role develops and the needs of the com

jobs.title: Mental Health Care Coordinator for High Needs Youth
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non\-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client\-centered, trauma\-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Position Details**


**Title**: Outpatient and C\-Change Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC)


**Classification**: Regular Full Time (1\.0 FTE), Non\-exempt (Hourly)


**Location**: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in\-person and complete documentation remotely)


**Regular Work Schedule**: Full time, M\-F


**Compensation:**


* $34\.62 per hour


The **Mental Health Care Coordinator,** formally known as the Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC) is responsible for the assessment, development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of intensive behavioral health, community\-based care plans for moderate to high\-acuity clients with complex behavioral health, medical, developmental, and/or psychosocial needs. The ICC identifies and brings together family, natural supports (friends, extended family, neighbors, community members) and formal system partners (child welfare, school, juvenile probation, etc.) to form a Child \& Family Team (CFT) which collectively works together to address goals and ensure successful and enduring change.



The ICC exercises clinical judgment and discretion in collaboratively evaluating client needs and strengths, determining appropriate interventions, coordinating interdisciplinary treatment services, managing crises, resource linkage, behavioral skill building and developing individualized care strategies guided by the Integrated Core Practice Model. The ICC coordinates and facilitates regular CFT meetings among teams, and monitors and contributes to progress toward a youth's goals.



The work is varied in character, requiring interpretation of clinical information, application of professional standards, and clinically informed decision\-making. ICCs provide services and participate in agency meetings in a combination of environments including virtual (zoom / phone) and in\-person office or community locations (drop\-in center, client homes, school, parks, etc.). This position primarily serves youth and young adults in the C\-Change program.


**About the C\-Change Program**



The C\-Change Program, supports the transformation of the lives of youth who are at risk or have been identified as sexually exploited minors by focusing on supporting stabilization, reducing mental health symptoms, self efficacy and self determination, community building, and connecting youth with other resources. Our specialized approach provides mental health screening, advocacy, clinical case management, and psychotherapy to at\-risk youth. C\-Change provides services to youth who are up to 21 years old and reside throughout the Bay Area.


**Responsibilities \& Competencies:**


* Assessment and Care Planning \- Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial, behavioral health, risk, and functional assessments for clients with complex and high\-acuity needs. Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of individualized care plans using evidence\-based and trauma\-informed practices. Evaluate clinical progress and modify interventions based on ongoing assessment and professional judgment.
* Facilitate Child \& Family Team (CFT) Meetings \- Regularly schedule, organize and facilitate CFT Meetings with youth/families and their community stakeholders. Facilitation training will be provided.
* Team\-Based Care \- Enthusiastically able to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary treatment team to support youth and families with developing and making progress toward their goals.
* Clinical Care \- Manage a caseload of up to 19 clients and ensure 50% (20 hrs / week) are dedicated to providing behavioral health services to youth and families; Uphold ethical and legal responsibilities, complete high quality documentation, link youth to resources, support skill building, assess needs, strengths \& provide crisis intervention and de\-escalation. Represents our mission, philosophy, and upholds ethical and legal responsibilities as a mandated reporter
* Crisis Intervention \& Clinical Decision Making \- Independently and collaboratively assess and respond to behavioral health crises, safety concerns, and urgent client situations. Exercise professional judgment in determining appropriate interventions, escalation procedures, mandated reporting obligations, and emergency referrals.
* Cultural Humility \- Awareness of the impacts of power, privilege, race and SOGIE on self, clients \& others.
* Efficiency and Time Management \- Ability to be well\-organized, manage time/schedule effectively, prioritize and complete timely documentation.
* Work in Community Environments \- Openness to providing services in a variety of community settings such as homes, schools, parks, shelters, other agencies, etc.
* Relationship\-Centered \- Understands the value of building healthy relationships to help youth navigate complex systems and how trauma can impact youth and team dynamics; Open to Restorative Justice Practices.
* Commitment to Ongoing Learning \- Ability to use supervision effectively; Ability to be self\-reflective and accountable to growth areas; passionate about learning and participating in ongoing training provided by WCC. Participate in individual and group supervision, program meetings and trainings consistently.
* Progress Notes and Clinical Documentation \- Knowledge of or ability to learn Medi\-Cal reimbursement procedures and billing; This position requires the completion of daily progress notes and other clinical documentation which complies with policies and procedures for meeting EPSDT Medi\-Cal and other billing requirements as set by WCC.

* At least 2 years of prof

jobs.title: Finance and HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position: Finance and HR Coordinator



JOB OVERVIEW:



Manage accounts to achieve guest satisfaction and solicit past and new business to ensure all revenue goals are achieved or exceeded. Conduct day to day operation of the hotel Human Resources department including but not limited to: creating a positive environment focusing on associate recognition, greet and communicate effectively in a timely fashion with internal and external guests including associates, assisting with Crescent and Hilton brand training to foster the message of the culture and goals, coordination of company and union benefits and enrollment process, assisting in the management of recruitment, hiring, training and development, respond to inquiries regarding policies, procedures, programs and escalating associate concerns and issues as necessary.



REPORTS TO: Director of Finance and Director of HR



ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:



Research and resolve credit card chargebacks and prepare responses to financial institutions.



Manage Accounts Payable processes to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant payments.



Reconcile vendor statements and follow up on discrepancies to prevent past\-due invoices.



Assist with the creation and processing of purchase orders.



Review purchase orders (including GL coding), invoices, and receipts for accuracy; upload approved documentation into BirchStreet.



Investigate, reconcile, and resolve invoices in exception and non\-matching status.



Accrue invoices not processed by the Accounts Payable month\-end cutoff.



Monitor and respond to the Accounts Payable mailbox, ensuring timely communication with vendors and internal stakeholders.



Prepare and record daily cash deposits in accordance with company policies and procedures.



Perform additional duties as assigned to support Finance and HR operations.



Greet and assist associates and guests who enter the Human Resources Department.



Manages, prepares, and processes payroll weekly including entering annual increases and contractual union increases.



Manages, prepares, and processes union benefits administration and billing.



Assist associates with requests and/or information.



Create or update Human Resource bulletin boards and other posting locations as needed. Ensure required postings are current and up to date.



Assist with associate events and recognition, as needed, e.g., Rising Star program, Anniversary Awards program, hotel brand required meetings, etc.



Explain elements of various benefits to associates as required. Assist with distribution of enrollment forms. Benefits include: Medical, Dental, Vision insurance, Life and Disability insurance, Flexible Spending accounts, Tuition Assistance, 401k and Paid Time Off.



Assist with filing and monitoring Worker Compensation claims. Alert Human Resource Director of any associate’s modified work duties.



Prepare department correspondence and memos as needed.



Maintain accurate associate files and other HR records including leave administration.



Schedule and hold orientation sessions and training for new hires and prepare necessary paperwork.



Coordinate all other pre\-selection activities, including drug testing; reference checks, etc., to ensure compliance with all Company policies and



Ensure all new hires and existing associates possess proper employment eligibility



Perform any other job\-related duties as assigned

  



REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:



Must have the ability to communicate in English. Must be able to juggle several tasks and have strong follow\-up skills. Must have high attention to detail. Self\-starting personality with an even disposition. Maintain a professional appearance and manner at all times. Working knowledge of Federal and local regulations relating to OSHA and worker's compensation. Working knowledge of Finance Accounts Payable and Human Resources practices and procedures as well as considerable knowledge of State and Federal laws and regulations pertaining to Finance and Human Resources matters. Ability to effectively deal with associates and external guests, some of whom will require high levels of patience, confidentiality, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger, resolve conflicts and collect accurate information.


*For applicants who will be working in California, the anticipated compensation range for the position is $30\.00 \- $ 35\.00 per hour, based on a 40\-hour work week. The salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include, but are not limited to years of experience within the job, years of experience within the required industry, education, work location, etc. Crescent Hotels is a multi\-state employer and the salary ranges indicated herein may not reflect positions that work only in other states.*

jobs.title: TAY Supportive Services Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Mission Statement**


Through the use of social and restorative justice principles, Five Keys provides traditionally underserved communities the opportunity to improve their lives through a focus on the Five Keys: EDUCATION, EMPLOYMENT, RECOVERY, FAMILY, COMMUNITY.




**Five Keys Overview**


Five Keys is a nonprofit organization that operates an extensive network of programs across California. With a presence in 14 counties and over 120 locations, Five Keys focuses on various initiatives aimed at empowering individuals and families to overcome poverty and inequity. The organization's programs encompass a wide range of services, including public charter schools, restorative justice programs in jails and prisons, shelters, permanent supportive housing, and the development of new housing and support programs. At Five Keys, the overarching objective is to uplift individuals and families by providing them with essential resources. This includes education, housing, employment, and the necessary tools to sustain their progress. By offering these fundamental elements, the organization aims to create positive and lasting change in communities, making them better places for everyone.




**Our Core Competencies**


A well qualified candidate has the capacity to communicate effectively, collaborate with others while building positive relationships, demonstrates strong problem solving skills, has a dynamic learning mindset, and remains committed to a high level of cultural and social awareness. A successful candidate will work well under pressure, observe appropriate boundaries and operate with a high degree of emotional intelligence.




**What it’s really like to join our agency…**


At Five Keys, culture matters. Culture is at the very core of everything we do and impact on a daily basis. We’ve made a commitment to building an inclusive culture that seeks collaboration over hierarchy to create empowered work teams. We serve vulnerable populations daily and we strive to approach everyone with compassion, patience and a trauma informed approach. We choose to push past discomfort to have difficult conversations to impact the greater good. This allows us the opportunity to collaboratively create an inclusive culture and transform the world around us.




**BENEFITS**


We offer very low monthly costs for medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with generous time off! Various pre\-tax flexible spending accounts and retirement account 403(b) are available. We provide annual reimbursements up to $100 towards gym membership, smoking cessation, and weight loss programs. Annual athletic event participation and annual massages are reimbursed up to $50\. Other Company\-paid benefits, including free wellness\-related apps, an Employee Assistance Program, and a comprehensive mental health care platform, are available to you and your dependents.  



**JOB SUMMARY**


The Transitional Age Youth (TAY) Supportive Services Care Coordinator reports to the Assistant Director of TAY Rapid Rehousing and is accountable for providing housing\-focused care coordination services to San Francisco clients (ages 18–27\) who receive rapid rehousing rental assistance through the San Francisco Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing and other City departments. This role requires a strong commitment to supporting youth as they transition out of homelessness, helping them build the skills and stability needed for long\-term self\-sufficiency. Team members are expected to demonstrate professionalism and integrity in every aspect of their work, ensuring the highest standards of service and opportunity for clients, community partners, and colleagues.




We are looking for someone who insists on maintaining a positive attitude and enjoys supporting a diverse group of people. If this job is for you, you are someone who is compassionate, collaborative, and deeply committed to equity and inclusion. You thrive in a fast\-paced environment, value the importance of strong client relationships, and are passionate about making a lasting impact in the lives of transitional age youth.




**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


Care Coordinator Duties

* Assist TAY participants with securing housing by providing navigation support, including accompanying them to view available units, helping complete housing applications, and facilitating access to credit and background reports as needed
* Support TAY participants in understanding their tenant rights, lease responsibilities, and requirements
* Provide guidance on timely rent payments, and coach them on effective communication and conflict resolution with landlords
* Develop case management plans and connect clients with community and government resources to avoid loss of benefits and to increase the likelihood of housing stability
* Deliver supportive services to help clients stabilize their housing, enhance their mental and physical well\-being, and build greater self\-sufficiency
* Make referrals and coordinate services that lead to increased housing stability, increased income, job placement assistance, and retention
* Work collaboratively with the rental assistance provider to determine and calculate appropriate rental assistance amounts for clients
* Support participants with swiftly transitioning out of the Rapid Rehousing Rental Assistance program while ensuring housing stabilization
* Plan and lead group Life Skills sessions covering topics such as budgeting, financial management, housing search strategies, nutrition, tenant\-landlord relationships, tenants’ rights, health education, healthcare navigation, and parenting, as applicable
* Develop and maintain comprehensive records for participating clients, including detailed case documentation and regular report reviews
* Compile and analyze data to prepare summary reports, ensuring all case files comply with both Five Keys case management standards and Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) requiremen

If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

* Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

  


**Necessary Qualifications:*** 3\-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus
* Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Must be extremely organized, self\-reliant, proactive, and detail\-oriented

  


**What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.


* Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

* Tuition reimbursement for associates

* 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel

jobs.description:
Description:

Now is the time to join Dentists of Santa Clara. You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!
Overview:

The primary role of the Healthcare Coordinator (HC) is to partner with supported Dentists to help gain a financial commitment from the patient to start the best course of treatment with urgency. Key responsibilities include understanding and utilizing financial options to support case acceptance, educating patients on treatment choices, overcoming common patient objections, and proactively keeping Dentist’s schedules productive. * Gain a financial commitment from the patient to start the dentistry that the Dentist is diagnosing for their patient
* Achieve proficiency in PDS system and tools, skills, and talents to assist patients in making the best possible decision for their unique wants and needs
* Executes the HC Handoff in partnership with each clinician on every exam patient
* Subject Matter Expert on all available financial options to give patients choices to start dentistry that fits in their budget
* Professionally overcome common patient objections to starting treatment
* Obtain necessary insurance pre\-authorizations for patients who need this prior to completing treatment
* Ensure the office is exemplifying the Comprehensive Care Model within the offices as well as referrals outside the office
* Active participant in daily morning huddles, monthly team meetings and any other meetings as required
* Thorough understanding of business imperatives and how the role directly impacts metrics and results
* Demonstrates stewardship of the PDS Brand making decisions consistent with the PDS Brand framework
* Becomes knowledgeable on the Mouth Body Connection and supports clinical excellence through comprehensive patient care
* Maintains an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor in accordance with company policies; addresses others professionally and respectfully always
* Ensures Compliance with Company policies, as well as State, Federal and other regulatory bodies
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**Qualifications*** High School Diploma or general education degree (GED)
* Travel might be required between offices

**Preferred*** Prior course work or on\-the\-job training in the fields or dentistry, insurance, or business

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities*** Knowledge of office practices, technology applications and patient insurances.
* Results Oriented (Energetic self\-starter; sets realistic goals; meets commitments; persistent, prioritizes daily to achieve results).

jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About WCN**


Wildlife Conservation Network is a rapidly growing leader in wildlife conservation, protecting endangered wildlife by supporting conservationists who ensure wildlife and people coexist and thrive. Using a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and philanthropically generous approach, WCN gives conservation leaders access to the donors, resources, and tools they need to reverse the crises facing threatened species — raising philanthropic funding and channeling it to a vetted network of Conservation Partners and through species\-focused Wildlife Funds that support over 125 species in more than 50 countries.

**Position Summary**


The Office Operations Coordinator keeps WCN's office, facilities, technology, events logistics, and finance\-support functions running day to day. This is a generalist role by design — the person in it moves across a wide range of tasks and prioritizes what's most urgent on a given day — and it's a strong entry point into nonprofit operations for someone early in their career who wants to grow. Reporting to the CFO, this role supports the whole organization and works most visibly alongside Donor Engagement and Events around Expo and other donor\-facing events. This role is anticipated to be in\-office full time.

**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**


This role keeps the operational backbone of WCN — office, technology, events, and finance\-support functions — running smoothly, freeing the organization to focus on its Conservation Partners, Wildlife Funds, and Rising Wildlife Leaders work in the field. It lives WCN's values directly: *Service* (the role exists to support other teams' work), *Integrity* (trustworthy handling of financially sensitive tasks like check deposits and petty cash), *Community* (visitor hospitality and internal culture/engagement support), and *Collaboration* (close partnership with Finance, Donor Engagement, and Events).

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Office \& Facilities** — Keep the physical office running day to day: phone coverage, visitor reception, supplies and systems, vendor relationships (e.g., janitorial), and a well\-organized, well\-used physical space.
* **Administrative Support** — Keep WCN organized and staff supported: general inquiries, mail, filing, new\-hire onboarding logistics, shared calendars, and employee engagement activities.
* **Finance Support** — Own the day\-to\-day financial tasks that keep operations running cleanly: check deposits (primary owner), petty cash, vendor invoices and payments, subscription tracking, and monthly credit card reconciliation, in close partnership with the Finance team.
* **Technology \& Equipment** — Maintain WCN's computer/equipment inventory and serve as the primary point of contact with WCN's IT support vendor.
* **Events \& Cross\-Team Support** — Coordinate staff and partner travel bookings and expense reporting, and support logistics for internal and external events, including Expo (storage, merchandise, partner packages).
* **Ad Hoc** — Take on cross\-departmental administrative support and special projects (Development, Programs, Finance) as they come up.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-3 years of office/administrative experience
* Strong general computer and technology skills (e.g., spreadsheets, documents, presentation software)
* Experience with cloud\-based collaborative tools (Google Drive, email); willingness to learn Salesforce basics with training
* Experience answering/routing calls on a multi\-line phone system or serving in a front\-desk/reception role
* Experience coordinating with vendors or service providers (scheduling, ordering, basic contract/invoice tracking)
* Familiarity with mail/shipping logistics (USPS, UPS, FedEx)
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable with variety and frequent interruptions (phones, visitors, vendors) rather than sustained single\-task focus; self\-directed enough to keep a long list of recurring tasks moving without close daily supervision
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds and sit for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Genuine interest in wildlife conservation and strong alignment with WCN's Core Values

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Compensation is expected to be in the $33\-36 an hour range based on qualifications and experience. Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance contributions; chiropractic/acupuncture; basic life insurance and AD\&D Health FSA and dependent care (pre\-tax); a retirement plan with a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 6% of salary; 11 paid holidays plus 1 paid floating holiday; 15 days of paid vacation in the first year (\+1 day per year worked); paid sick leave; and employee wellness, mental health, and discount programs.

**Equal Opportunity**


WCN is committed to the principles of being an equal opportunity employer (EOE). WCN’s organizational policies, practices, programs, activities and decisions regarding employment are not based on a person’s race, color, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, parental status, housing status, or other protected status, in accordance with applicable law. Black, Indigenous, people of color, women, individuals identifying with the LGBTQIA\+ community, or members of other underrepresented groups in the conservation sector are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Analyst to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process automation and documentation.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

SteppingStone Adult Day Health is San Francisco's largest provider of adult day health care. Licensed by the State Department of Public Health and certified as a Medi\-Cal provider with the California Department of Aging, the organization has worked tirelessly since 1983 to help seniors and disabled adults thrive and overcome the obstacles to independent living by providing a cost\-effective, stimulating, and comprehensive set of health and social services. SteppingStone also operates three supplementary programs under the umbrella of adult day health care – Enhanced Care Coordination that focuses on community living and an aging\-in\-place approach, the LGBTQ\+ Community Services program and the Alzheimer’s Day Care Resource Center. The Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Project at SteppingStone is a program designed to provide comprehensive care coordination and management services to individuals with complex medical and behavioral health needs. The program is aimed at improving the health outcomes and quality of life for participants, many of whom are elderly or disabled and require multiple services and treatments. The program is funded through the California Department of Health Care Services and operates under the state's Medi\-Cal managed care program. ECM has been successful in improving health outcomes and reducing hospitalizations for participants, while also providing much\-needed support and resources to caregivers and families.

Job Summary: Under the supervision of the Enhanced Care Management Program Director, the Enhanced Care Management Program Manager is responsible for assisting in the implementation and ongoing management of the Enhanced Care Management program. This program provides personalized care and support to patients with complex medical needs to improve their health outcomes and quality of life. The Program Manager will work closely with the Program Director and care management team to ensure effective coordination of care and communication with patients, healthcare providers, and community resources. The Program Manager will also be responsible for program evaluation and quality improvement efforts in coordination with the Program Director.

**Physical Demands:**  The ECM Program Manager may need to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods of time and may need to lift or move patients or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to focus.

The Product Risk Program Manager, Evidencing and Monitoring will join the Assessor Engagement team within the Product Risk Program Manager organization. This role is responsible for coordinating and providing evidence for Privacy Review Safeguards, owning Key Control Indicator (KCI) creation, maintenance, and monitoring, and ensuring data quality and reproducibility across all compliance artifacts. They will build and maintain complex data pipelines and queries (Presto/Hive) to support external regulatory requests, produce reproducible evidence packages, and defend data methodologies during regulatory engagements. This role bridges the gap between engineering and compliance, requiring both technical depth (SQL, Python, Hack) and the ability to communicate findings clearly to external regulators and internal stakeholders including product, engineering, legal, and risk subject matter experts. Additionally, this role is responsible for conducting various audit types, assessing risk determinations for accuracy, including ensuring that approved privacy decisions include all relevant risks and related mitigations. jobs.description:
**Location:** Bay Area


**Our Team:**

Semtech's commercial (sales) team is a high\-performing, strategic group driving Semtech's transformation into an industry\-leading demand generation organization. We recognize that our rep partners are strategic extensions of our go\-to\-market engine and critical force multipliers for reaching customers we can't serve directly. We thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment where tenacity, grit, and collaboration define our culture, measuring success by the trust we build with customers and partners, the innovative solutions we deliver together, and the market share we capture through disciplined execution.  



**Job Summary** **:**

The Strategic Account Manager is quota\-carrying regional sales position that will serve as a market share warrior, trusted customer advisor, and strategic partner orchestrator—driving explosive revenue growth through world\-class demand generation across direct accounts and rep\-covered territories. This high\-impact position combines strategic vision with competitive sales instincts, orchestrating complex deals while building best\-in\-class rep firm relationships that multiply market reach. You'll be part business strategist, part performance coach , part trusted advisor, and part market intelligence officer— leveraging deep customer intimacy and systematic rep enablement to outmaneuver competition.  



Your dual mandate spans the full Semtech portfolio: secure design wins with direct strategic accounts while building rep firm capability, alignment, and performance that amplifies your impact across territories. Success requires becoming a trusted advisor whom customers welcome into confidential discussions while creating strategic partnerships where rep firm success directly fuels Semtech's growth. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover business consequences and decision criteria driving customer choices, while coaching reps to do the same. Success will be measured by market share gains, customer and partner loyalty, design\-win velocity, and pipeline conversion at industry\-leading rates. Time allocation between direct accounts and rep firms flexes based on territory revenue mix and growth potential, requiring strategic prioritization and dynamic resource optimization.  



**Responsibilities** **:**

Strategic Account Management, Revenue Growth \& Design\-Win Pursuit


* Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for assigned customer accounts using consultative discovery methodologies
* Build strategic customer relationships to identify opportunities for Semtech solutions across multiple product lines
* Drive annual revenue achievement through strategic account development, design\-win pursuit, and production ramp management
* Partner with FAEs to drive technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and design\-in activities for direct accounts
* Translate customer technical requirements into compelling business cases and commercial proposals
* Track design\-win funnel from engagement through qualification and production ramp
* Build and maintain qualified pipeline of 3\-4x quota coverage with systematic opportunity progression
* Lead pricing negotiations, MSA/NDA execution, and commercial terms protecting margins
* Cultivate executive relationships with procurement, supply chain, and engineering management
* Coordinate customer technical and commercial issue resolution across internal resources

* Partner with rep firms and FAEs to drive technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and design\-in activities across rep\-covered accounts

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


Harvey is looking for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager to lead a high\-performing support team serving lawyers and professional services teams. Our customers hold their own work to a high standard of accuracy and timeliness, and expect the same from our support. How well your region runs is one of the biggest levers Harvey has on what customers actually experience when they need help. Reporting to the Head of CX, you'll drive operational excellence and accountability across Harvey's global support organization.


You'll balance strategic oversight with hands\-on execution. This is a role for a leader who thrives in motion: proactive, decisive, and deeply motivated by achieving results through your team. You'll inherit a metric set and processes that need to be better, and we expect you to diagnose what's broken and fix it without being asked.


You'll also be one of five CX Managers across the globe, and that peer group is where our operating standard gets set. You're expected to trade what's working across regions and push for the changes you think we should make everywhere, shaping the culture and cadence of a growing support organization.

* Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.
* Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.
* Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support the client relationship management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
