jobs.title: Care Management Community Health Worker I
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**: As part of an interdisciplinary team, provides culturally affirmative care coordination and advocacy for patients. This includes outreach and engagement, social assessments and development of the care plan, health coaching, and linkage to social resources and healthcare.


**DUTIES \& ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**: NOTE: Following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.


1\. Coordinates patient care activities in partnership with other members of the healthcare team, the patient, the patient’s representatives, and community partners; makes referrals as appropriate.


2\. Completes screening and assessments to determine patient’s health and psychosocial barriers to care and wellness needs. Communicates results to healthcare team, as necessary.


3\. Creates, implements and maintains care plan based on assessments.


4\. Prepares case reports; documents assessment, progress notes and related information as required by Medicare, MediCal, Title 22 and other mandated regulations according to Department standards; prepares correspondence regarding patient intake or follow\-up and documents in the EHR.


5\. Identifies and coordinates referrals and linkage between patients and families to community resources that will assist them in achieving positive health outcomes; may contact agencies/community\-based organizations on patients’ behalf.


6\. Educates team and allied service providers about community needs and perspectives.


7\. Engages patients in home and community environments, as needed.


8\. Encourages access to appropriate care, and self\-management strategies through strengths\-based health coaching and navigation support.


9\. Mediates barriers impairing patients’ ability to manage wellness and supports adherence to health improvement or treatment plan.


10\. Enrolls patient in ADAP on an annual basis, or as needed (Adult Immunology Clinic)


11\. Conducts HIV testing and counseling at community events as needed (Adult Immunology Clinic)


12\. Coordinates repair, emission checks and service activities and maintains records of vehicle maintenance, equipment and operating expenses. Drives and operates the mobile health van to field sites (i.e. shelters, parks and meal sites) on a scheduled basis. Ensures the van is maintained/cleaned and vehicle maintenance and housekeeping logs are kept current. (Mobile Health Clinic)


13\. Completes Bedside assessments in a manner that is friendly, helpful, informative and supports their participation in medical care. (required for certain positions)


14\. Partners with patients during in\-person warm hand\-offs from medical and allied providers to provide in immediate needs assessment and initial provision of resources (required for certain positions)


15\. Performs other duties as assigned.


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**:  

Required Education: High School Diploma or equivalent.


Required Experience: One year’s experience in a public sector or health care service capacity, performing duties such as direct patient outreach, care coordination and linkage to community resources.


Preferred Experience: Individual history that aligns with and provides a connection to community or population being served.


Required Licenses/Certifications: Must be eligible to sign self\-attestation of lived experience, as defined by California Department of Healthcare Services (DHCS): CHWs must have lived experience that aligns with and provides a connection between the CHW and the community or population being served. This may include, but is not limited to, lived experience related to incarceration, military service, pregnancy and birth, disability, foster system placement, homelessness, mental health conditions or substance use, or being a survivor of domestic or intimate partner violence or abuse and exploitation. Lived experience may also include shared race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, language, or cultural background of one or more linguistic, cultural, or other groups in the community for which the CHW is providing services.


Preferred Licenses/Certifications: Community Health Worker certification; Emergency Technician certification. ADAP, HIV testing/Counseling certification


Required Experience: Minimum 20 hours of driving experience of large vehicles in excess of 15 ft. (Mobile Health Department)


Required Experience: Knowledge of HIV services in Alameda County, and competence in cultural differences, HIV/AIDS, minority health, sexual practices, and a demonstrated competence in working with people who use substances, Black/AA, Indigenous and other people of color, LGBT, and youth communities. (AIC Clinic)


Required Licenses/Certifications: Valid California Class C driver’s license and good driving record. (certain positions only)


Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.


PAY RANGE: $41\.34 \- $50\.25/ per hour  

*The pay range for this position reflects the base pay scale for the role at Alameda Health System. Final compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s experience, education, skills, licenses and certifications, departmental equity, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and the operational needs of the organization. Alameda Health System also offers eligible positions a generous comprehensive benefits program.*

  


Location: Alameda Health System · Health Home \& Complex Care  

Schedule: Full Time, Day

jobs.title: Enrollment Specialist
jobs.description:
**The Problem**



Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment\-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.



What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.



We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.



**The Problem**



Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment\-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.



What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.



We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.


**Who We Are**



Amae Health is a Series B, venture\-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high\-acuity, in\-person clinics nationwide.



Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork\-Presbyterian, Cedars\-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—partner with us to expand this level of care.



Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI\-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.



The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.


**The Team**



We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.



Our teams work cross\-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.



Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.



**The Opportunity:**
Amae Health is seeking a dedicated and empathetic Enrollment Specialist to join our team in delivering exceptional care to adults with complex needs. This is a full\-time, fully remote role, working Monday–Friday, 10:00am \- 6:00 PM PST. **We are currently only considering candidates located in the PST, MST, or CST time zones.**

The Enrollment Specialist serves as the first point of contact for Amae Health and plays a critical role in creating a lasting, meaningful first impression for prospective patients and their families. As an extension of our care teams, Enrollment Specialists partner closely with patients, families, social workers, and hospital systems to facilitate access to care and support the intake and referral process at Amae Health.

**What you'll work on:**
* Answer inbound calls from potential patients, families, caregivers, hospitals, and social workers.
* Review potential members' Verification of Benefits (VOB) and understand coverage details, including copays, deductibles, and out\-of\-pocket costs.
* Conduct outbound calls to follow up on patient referrals and coordinate with hospitals, social workers, patients, and families.
* Engage with social workers to understand patient needs and encourage referrals to Amae Health.
* Use clear, articulate communication to convey information about Amae Health's services.
* Schedule and follow up on calls to ensure ongoing communication and referral progress.
* Maintain accurate records of interactions and follow\-up activities in the CRM system.
* Provide compassionate, empathetic support to patients, families, and social workers.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless referral process and high\-quality patient care.

**About You:**

You are compassionate, empathetic, and comfortable having supportive conversations about complex mental health experiences. You bring high emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and comfort in a phone\-based environment. Goal\-oriented and resourceful, you follow through to help patients access care at Amae Health and are excited to be part of a collaborative team making a meaningful impact for individuals with severe mental illness.



**What you'll have**:
* 2\+ years of customer service experience in a healthcare\-related setting
* Experience in the mental health field (preferred)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Persistent, resourceful, and proactive in securing patient referrals and supporting patients throughout the enrollment process
* Strong proficiency with CRM systems and computer applications (e.g., Slack, Google Suite, RingCentral)
* Empathetic and compassionate when handling sensitive patient information and situations
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Able to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team

**What We Provide:**

Amae Health is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to take care of you now and in the future, focusing on your personal, financial and professional wellness.

This is a highly active, relationship\-based role focused on hands\-on support, in\-person outreach, new patient onboarding, and helping patients overcome barriers to accessing care.



You may support patients with a wide range of needs, including care plan follow\-up, blood pressure checks, connecting patients to resources, and delivering groceries or care packages when needed.


### **High\-Volume Field\-Based Care Management**



This is a fast\-paced, high\-volume role supporting a large and complex patient population across **Alameda County**. **Field Care Coordinators** are expected to be in the community **five days per week**, meeting patients where they are and managing a busy daily field schedule.

jobs.title: Clinical Account Manager (Northern California)
jobs.description:
**About Cleerly**



We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location.



Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks.



At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.



While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.

*Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.*

**About the Opportunity**

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**  

Bobyard uses AI to take contractors from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. We're Series A backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear ($35M — 2x the median raise), and our customers are running real construction jobs on Bobyard right now, not sitting through a demo.

 **About the Role**  

Implementation Specialist runs the day\-to\-day work of getting new mid\-market customers live and trained on Bobyard. We're building this role because launch quality can't scale on ad hoc effort — someone needs to own kickoff calls, configuration, and training as a repeatable motion, at volume. You'll win when a customer's team is actually using Bobyard on real jobs, not just logged in, and when you can run that outcome across a full book of accounts every month, not just one at a time.

 **What You'll Do**

* Run kickoff calls and configure new mid\-market accounts so they're ready to go within days of signature, not weeks
* Deliver hands\-on training that gets real crews — estimators, PMs, field staff — actually using Bobyard, not just clicking through a demo
* Own a high\-volume book of concurrent launches and keep every one of them moving without dropping details
* Run repeatable training sessions and office hours, refining the curriculum as you see what actually lands with users
* Catch stragglers early — flag accounts that are stalling before they quietly go dark
* Document account context well enough that Customer Success can pick it up cold with zero re\-explaining
* Feed real, specific product and training feedback back to Product and Customer Success

 **What We're Looking For**

* 2\+ years in a customer\-facing SaaS role — onboarding, implementation, training, or customer success
* Comfortable running live training for non\-technical or field\-based users, not just technical buyers
* Can juggle a high\-volume portfolio of accounts at once without losing the thread on any of them
* Clear, concrete written communication — your notes are why the next person never has to ask what happened
* Hands\-on with software yourself — you configure things, you don't wait on someone else to do it
* Genuinely energized by construction, trades, or other real\-world industries
* No SaaS background required if you've got the industry instead — if you've run estimates, managed jobs, or worked the trades and want to move into tech, you'll pick this up fast

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech
* Familiarity with CRM or onboarding tooling (Salesforce, Asana, Notion)
* Prior experience in construction, estimating, or the trades
* Bilingual (Spanish or otherwise) — useful with field crews

 **What We Offer**
  

  

$85,000–$110,000 base salary, plus equity. Based in San Francisco, on\-site with the team at 101 2nd Street.

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $100K

jobs.description:
Included Health is looking for a Senior Recruiting Program Manager to lead a portfolio of recruiting programs and operational improvements. This role will focus on several key areas including internal mobility, talent brand, and process improvement. They will also manage the contingent workforce programs. Furthermore, the role will support change management for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.



This is a strategic program\-owner role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguous problems, connect business goals to execution, and drive measurable outcomes across multiple teams. The successful candidate will be a trusted advisor to Talent Acquisition management and other partners. They will influence others without direct authority, help shift programs from planning to adoption, and will ensure continuous improvement.



### **Responsibilities**


### **Recruiting Program Portfolio**


* Own recruiting programs from planning through execution, measurement, and iteration.
* Build clear program plans, milestones, stakeholder maps, risks, decisions, communications, and success measures.
* Lead the operational development of an internal mobility program.
* Support talent\-brand programs that strengthen Included Health’s employer brand proposition, diversify sources of hire, and improve the candidate experience.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to assess progress, identify risks, and recommend action.

### **Process Improvement**


* Identify friction across the recruiting lifecycle and design simpler, more consistent ways of working.
* Improve processes through standardization, documentation, automation opportunities, and clear ownership.
* Incorporate AI and technology into recruiting processes to automate manual work, improve efficiency, and scale operations.

* Lead change\-management efforts for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.

* Deep knowledge of recruiting processes, stakeholder needs, and the candidate, manager, and recruiter experience.

* Strong project and program\-management skills, including planning, governance, risk management, prioritization, and executive communication.
* Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.

* Strong judgment, organization, follow\-through, and comfort balancing strategic priorities with operational detail.

* Experience designing agency governance, vendor scorecards, contingent\-workforce operating models, or workforce planning processes.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting
jobs.description:
Included Health is seeking a Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting, to build and run the operating system for our highest\-volume hiring areas, initially Clinical, Behavioral Health and Member Care.



This role will create consistent operating cadence across high\-volume pods, improve funnel performance, manage agency and vendor effectiveness, and expand the use of automation and AI\-enabled workflows. The PM will translate hiring goals into capacity plans, identify risks early, and drive corrective action across the recruiting machine.



This is not a traditional recruiting coordinator or status\-reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a program owner: diagnosing problems, recommending solutions, and holding cross\-functional partners accountable for measurable outcomes.



### **Responsibilities:**


### **High\-Volume Operating Model**


* Build and maintain a standardized operating model across high\-volume recruiting pods.
* Establish operating cadences, planning processes, scorecards, and escalation paths.
* Translate hiring goals into funnel requirements, capacity plans, and execution priorities.
* Maintain a consolidated view of hiring health, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
* Partner with pod owners to improve pacing, stakeholder readiness, funnel quality, and delivery against goals.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and scale the high\-volume model across additional hiring areas.

### **Agency and Vendor Management**


* Own day\-to\-day operating performance for high\-volume agency and vendor partners.
* Establish clear expectations and scorecards covering submissions, quality, fill rate, time\-to\-fill, pricing, responsiveness, and corrective action.
* Create a consistent process for agency onboarding, performance reviews, escalation, and offboarding.
* Shift routine agency management and reporting away from senior leaders and toward exception\-based escalation.
* Recommend when work should be handled internally, through contractors, agencies, or automation based on demand, economics, speed, role complexity, and available capacity.


**Automation and AI\-Enabled Recruiting**
* Expand BrightHire, AI interviewer, and related workflow adoption across high\-volume recruiting.
* Partner with Talent Operations on workflow design, tooling, and automation opportunities.
* Automate reporting, funnel tracking, quality monitoring, and partner performance visibility.
* Identify friction points and run targeted process\-improvement pilots.
* Measure the impact of automation through recruiter hours saved, funnel conversion, time\-to\-fill, quality, and candidate experience.

* Own the consolidated weekly high\-volume hiring health report.
* Report on open requisitions, aging, progress to goal, funnel health, capacity, internal versus agency mix, and at\-risk work.

* Use data to distinguish capacity gaps from execution, process, quality, prioritization, or stakeholder issues.
* Build clear recommendations for resourcing, agency allocation, and process changes.

* Experience using AI\-enabled recruiting workflows.
* Strong understanding of recruiting funnels, capacity planning, conversion metrics, and hiring economics.

* Experience improving processes through automation, technology, or workflow redesign.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders.
* Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-changing environment.
* Sound judgment, urgency, and comfort surfacing risk early.
### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting Clinical, Behavioral Health, Member Care, Urgent Care, or other high\-volume hiring environments.
* Experience with recruiting systems such as Lever, BrightHire, or similar tools.
* Experience building agency scorecards, operating dashboards, or capacity models.
* Experience partnering with senior Talent Acquisition or business leaders on workforce planning.
### **Success in This Role Looks Like:**


* High\-volume pods operate against a consistent cadence, shared metrics, and clear ownership model.
* Agency and vendor performance is visible, managed against defined expectations, and escalated appropriately.

* Recruiter and pod\-owner time shifts away from manual reporting and routine coordination toward higher\-value recruiting work.

* TA leaders have a reliable, consolidated view of high\-volume hiring performance.
* The High Volume operating model becomes repeatable across additional hiring areas.

jobs.description:

**This role is fully remote and must be located within the 50 U.S. states. Preference for residence in the Greater Boston Area. Standard working hours are in Eastern Timezone. Semi\-annual travel may be required to a Devoted office for on\-site work.**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented Operations Manager to support medical record retrieval and management for a new and highly critical area of work for Devoted’s Risk Adjustment Operations. Join CarepathRx as an Account Manager, where you will help patients transition safely and confidently from hospital care to home\-based therapy. At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

  



**Who We Are**

  

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.


Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.


We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

* Proactively provide updated information regarding status of contract, outstanding requirements, and transaction explanations. Use critical thinking skills to address unusual situations; escalate concerns and/or complex cases as necessary.
* Process transactions; meet speed of service and quality goals for each task function.
* Interact with teams across functional areas to facilitate timely responses to actions pending.
* Follow up with agents on policy delivery requirements to ensure policy is placed within specified timeframes.
* Provide information on a variety of complex agent service issues requiring knowledge of insurance products and transactions with a focus on agent satisfaction, quality, and efficiency. Consult with other departments as necessary.

* Associate’s degree in a business field or equivalent education/experience
* One year of financial services operations or related industry experience
* Excellent communication skills that are clear and professional – both written and verbal

* Strong problem solving and decision making skills
* Attention to detail and the ability to multi\-task

* Proficiency using MS Office

* Knowledge of life and/or annuity products/operations

jobs.title: Site Quality Manager - Gas Power Generation
jobs.description:
Blattner is expanding our energy construction leadership into gas power generation. This is a unique opportunity to help build this new business from the ground up, backed by a company with decades of proven success in the energy sector. This position will help us shape the processes and standards that carry this business forward to deliver end\-to\-end hybrid energy solutions.


The Site Quality Manager is a champion of Blattner’s quality culture and verifies that Blattner’s Quality Program is being delivered by the project teams. They serve as a technical subject matter expert and technical consultant, supporting the Site Quality Coordinators and Quality department overall. They mentor Site Quality Coordinators on technical knowledge, inspection and testing methodologies, management and coaching of Quality Control Inspectors, as well as engagement techniques that strengthens the quality culture at the project level. These engagement techniques are applicable to interactions with Blattner construction personnel, as well as Client representatives.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE**

* Assesses Blattner’s Quality Culture and verifies that Blattner’s Quality Program is understood, followed, enforced, and consistently applied across projects to ensure project teams deliver a quality project in a safe and efficient manner.
* Acts as the subject matter expert with the development, implementation, and continued refinement of Inspection Instructions and Test Instructions, while collaborating with the General Superintendents Construction and Quality Department during these efforts.
* Trains, develops, and mentors Site Quality Coordinators to ensure the Quality Control team is integrated as a part of the project team, creating, and sustaining a proactive quality culture.
* Supports Site Quality Coordinators in establishing accurate and efficient Quality Control Work Plans for each project.
* Assists site management in the training and coaching of Construction personnel as it relates to Quality Assurance efforts, analyzing trends, and problem solving to proactively mitigate quality, safety, and waste exposures.
* Promotes the expectation that all employees operate in accordance with Standard Work Instructions and mandatory operating procedures.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar Global Solutions delivers a broad array of planning, analysis and risk management solutions, project and program management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and installations, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**


Versar is seeking a full\-time Project Manager (PM) to support physical Electronic Security System (ESS) installation projects nationwide in support of the United States Marshals Service (USMS). The ideal candidate will be self\-motivated with the ability to work independently with some oversite. Additionally, the candidate must have experience with the performance and supervision of tasks related to electronic security systems (i.e., Access Control, CCTV, Video Management, Intrusion Detection, Intercoms etc.), and in managing the performance of projects, including people, schedule, scope, quality control, and budget. Further, the candidate will have experience working with other trades, i.e., construction, IT, and client stakeholders. The PM will be the senior subject matter expert and monitor, control and report status on cost, schedule and performance.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide overall management of multiple projects mainly on customer sites with some availability for remote work. Extensive travel will be required around the project schedules.
* Meet or exceed client project execution requirements through effective allocation of resources, and by ensuring high quality work, following budget and schedule parameters.
* Manage internal resources and subcontractors. This includes, but is not limited to, verifying quality of installation and deliverables, evaluating percent complete for subcontracted tasks, evaluating equipment and materials used to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and standards, validating invoices for payment, negotiating costs, and managing scope change.
* Ensure contractual compliance with all installation activities, deliverables, and schedule.
* Manage and document inventory of all equipment and material purchased for the project and/or shipped to the project site for installation.
* Ensure internal project management procedures are followed, including project revenue forecasting and estimate at completion.
* Ensure all projects are carried out safely in accordance with Versar’s safety requirements.
* Meet with and/or report weekly to internal and external stakeholder entities.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3\-5 years of verifiable project management experience.
* Proficiency with MS Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Project.
* Professional experience in the systems administration field with three years of overall experience in Microsoft Windows client and server operating systems.
* Certifications, or have the capability to obtain certifications, in Hirsch, Bosch BVMS, and Bosch IDS, and experience with Commend, Aiphone, Inovonics, and networks.
* Prior experience as a project manager for ESS projects with a full understanding of managing clients, financials, vendor relationships, subcontractors, and project level staff.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Minimum five (5\) years of experience with electronic security systems, specifically hands\-on experience in installing, configuring, maintaining, and resolving issues with Intrusion Detection Systems, Access Control Systems and Video Management Systems.

Expected Salary: $100,000 to $120,000 per year

jobs.title: Publishing Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named \#2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

 **Job Summary**


The Publishing Onboarding Manager runs assigned publishing catalog transitions end to end, from deal handoff through steady\-state administration. Executes the standard onboarding playbook across catalog ingestion, registration, and works delivery to societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints, and owns the identification and redirection of rights and royalty streams for assigned catalogs. * Executes registration and works delivery for assigned catalogs to societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints including YouTube, including CWR submission, acknowledgement processing, and remediation of non\-accepted works.
* Owns the identification, transfer, and redirection of rights and royalty streams in assigned catalogs, including US and CA PROs (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, SOCAN), mechanical and digital collections, and international collection.
* Liaises with the M\&A team on prior\-administrator wind\-down for assigned deals, which the M\&A team leads, ensuring pipeline income is captured and revenue leakage prevented during handover.
* Liaises with Royalties, Business Affairs, and/or Legal on third\-party payment obligations for assigned catalogs, including payee changes and account setup, ensuring these are initiated and completed on time during each transition.
* Manages several transitions at once, maintaining current per\-deal status in Atlas and checking in with stakeholders on a frequent informal cadence between formal reviews.

* Hands\-on catalog ingestion: validating works, writers, splits, and identifiers against deal schedules
* Registration and delivery to PROs, mechanical societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints

\*\* This is a contract role. **Duration**: suggested 6 months, with an option to extend. **Hours:** 20\-30 per week\*\*  

  

**Company Overview**
--------------------


Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

**Role**
--------

As Function Health expands globally, with active hiring in LATAM, momentum in the UK, and plans for further international growth, we are establishing a strategic foundation to support our international workforce. To ensure long\-term success, we are proactively designing a scalable, compliant, and optimized global operating model.  

  

We are seeking a contractor to lead our global workforce strategy workstream. In this role, you will serve as the project manager and strategic connective tissue across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leadership. You will build comprehensive cost\-benefit analyses to identify the optimal engagement model for each market, drive key strategic decisions to closure, and establish a clear, repeatable framework that empowers our team to scale sustainably for the future.  

  

This is a hands\-on delivery role, not an advisory one. Success looks like decisions made, guardrails published, and a repeatable playbook in place by the end of the engagement.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the global workforce strategy work stream end to end \- scope, plan, milestones, risks, and status reporting to leadership.
* Build a comprehensive cost\-benefit analysis across our international footprint, covering contractor\-to\-EOR conversions, new EOR implementations, and the threshold at which standing up a legal entity is the better long\-term investment.
* Develop a scalable decision framework for choosing between contractor, EOR, and entity models, weighted for cost, compliance risk, speed, candidate experience, and long\-term operating complexity.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across People, Legal, Finance, Tax, and business leaders \- surfacing tradeoffs, forcing the open questions, and getting to a decision rather than another meeting.
* Support UK expansion, including evaluation and potential entity creation, on a timeline that lands before year\-end.
* Partner with engineering leadership on LATAM hiring plans, giving them the data and framework to evaluate tradeoffs before commitments are made.
* Define clear guardrails and operating principles for contractor engagements including eligibility for employee programs, benefits, and equity.
* Establish lightweight governance: intake process, decision rights, escalation path, and turnaround expectations, so requests stop being handled reactively.
* Document everything and run a clean handoff \- playbooks, templates, and decision logs that outlast the engagement.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 7\+ years in program or project management with direct ownership of international workforce, global mobility and expansion, or global HR operations initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with EOR platforms and implementations, contractor engagement models, and the economics and mechanics of establishing legal entities in a new market.
* Working knowledge of the risk landscape: worker classification, permanent establishment, payroll and employment tax, work authorization, benefits, and statutory requirements.
* Direct experience working with LATAM and the UK markets.
* Strong financial modeling instincts. Able to build a defensible fully\-loaded cost comparison across models and markets, and explain it to a CFO.
* Proven ability to drive alignment and decisions across senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* Crisp written communication; comfortable writing the exec memo and the operating doc with equal quality.
* Ability to move fast in an ambiguous, high\-growth environment and bring structure without adding bureaucracy.
  

  

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry
* Prior work at a company scaling from first international hires to a multi\-entity footprint.
* Familiarity with equity administration across contractor and EOR populations.
  

  

**To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values**
--------------------------------------------------


* Ruthless Prioritization:
	+ We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
	+ We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
	+ We prioritize what drives impact.
	+ We never compromise on standards of excellence.

**Position Overview**

CCG is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Section 508 Support Services task order. The DHS Office of the Chief Information Officer, Experience and Accessibility Directorate (EAD) sets the Department's vision and strategic direction for ensuring that all Information and Communications Technology (ICT) procured, maintained, or used by DHS is accessible to employees and customers with disabilities. In this role, you will serve as the single point of contact to the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative, direct all contractor support work performed under the Statement of Work, and manage the schedule, staffing, deliverables, and reporting that keep the Section 508 program running across the Department.

**Responsibilities**

* **Government Interface:** Serve as the single point of contact for the Contracting Officer and the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), remain available by telephone between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. EST Monday through Friday, and respond to requests to discuss or resolve technical problems within 24 hours of notification.
* **Reporting:** Provide a monthly progress report to the Contracting Officer and COR by the 15th day of the following month, summarizing all contractor work performed, labor hours by category, direct costs by line item, technical progress, schedule status, and any contractor concerns or recommendations.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Meet virtually with the COR and other designated federal personnel to present deliverables, discuss progress, exchange information, and resolve emergent technical issues.
* **Events and Outreach:** Support events and activities requiring presentations or contractor presence, ensuring all materials are prepared, delivered, accessible, and retrieved efficiently.
* **Deliverable Quality and Compliance:** Ensure all written reports and deliverables are accurate, on time, Section 508 conformant, and compatible with DHS workstations and Microsoft Office applications, and ensure contractor personnel understand and follow DHS rules, regulations, and policies governing conduct, safety, and security.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum of three years of experience managing projects of similar size and complexity.
* Experience managing federal government contracts or task orders and serving as the primary point of contact to a Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer's Representative.
* Demonstrated experience producing standard project management deliverables, including project plans, staffing plans, business continuity plans, and recurring monthly progress and status reports.
* Experience planning, staffing, and managing distributed or fully remote technical teams, including recruitment, retention, and replacement of personnel.
* Working knowledge of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, the Revised Section 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194\), and WCAG 2\.0 Level A and AA success criteria as they apply to ICT.
* Ability to track cost, schedule, and technical performance and report status clearly to both technical staff and senior government leadership.
* Ability to produce written deliverables that meet Section 508 standards for electronic content, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience supporting a DHS component or another federal Office of the Chief Information Officer, particularly an IT accessibility or Section 508 program.
* Familiarity with the DHS Trusted Tester program, the DHS Section 508 Playbook, or IAAP certifications such as CPACC or WAS.
* Experience with ServiceNow\-based ticketing and reporting platforms, such as the Accessibility Compliance Management System (ACMS).
* Experience supporting IT governance and acquisition review processes, such as IT Acquisition Reviews (ITARs) or change control boards

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent certifications. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) strongly preferred.

U.S. Citizenship

Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

As the Project Manager, you will oversee end\-to\-end execution, sprint planning, and workflow governance across all six pillars of our Digital department: Software Development, Product Management, Design, Business Intelligence, Digital Marketing, and IT. Working directly under the Director of Technology, you will translate strategic directives into structured execution roadmaps, optimize cross\-functional intake processes, and keep multi\-disciplinary projects moving on deadline.

You will serve as the central operational engine—eliminating execution bottlenecks, aligning internal teams and contractors, and providing transparent reporting to executive leadership to ensure our technology stack scales predictably and efficiently.

**This is an independent contractor position, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere within the United States.**

Contract consists of a competitive hourly rate with approximately 120\-160 hours available per month, depending on the agreed\-upon hourly rate.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**● Project Management \& Process Optimization:** Oversee and continuously improve project management processes across Software Development, Product, Design, BI, Digital Marketing, and IT. Manage ClickUp governance, workflows, and reporting.

**● Sprint \& Workflow Management:** Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, task allocation, and cross\-functional handoffs to maintain project momentum and delivery.

**● Timeline \& Risk Management:** Develop project schedules, track milestones and dependencies, identify risks, and proactively address roadblocks to keep initiatives on schedule.

**● Stakeholder Communication:** Serve as the operational link between teams, contractors, and leadership, providing clear updates on project health, priorities, risks, and milestones.

**● Intake \& Priority Management:** Manage incoming requests, align priorities with business goals and team capacity, and prevent scope creep.

**● Documentation \& Resource Coordination:** Maintain project documentation, decision and risk logs, SOPs, budgets, contractor resources, and vendor deliverables.

**● Quality \& Launch Readiness:** Coordinate QA, UAT, approvals, and cross\-functional launch readiness for digital initiatives and system enhancements.

**● Team Facilitation:** Lead standups, planning sessions, sprint reviews, and retrospectives while driving accountability and effective collaboration.

**● Continuous Improvement:** Monitor project and operational metrics, evaluate outcomes, and implement Agile, Lean, and AI\-assisted practices to improve efficiency and execution.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

● 3\+ years of professional project management experience directly leading cross\-functional teams in a digital, software development, or technology\-focused environment.

● Demonstrated command of project management frameworks and tooling, with deep hands\-on expertise in ClickUp (or equivalent platforms like Jira/Asana) for backlog, sprint, and dashboard management.

● Proven track record managing multi\-disciplinary projects spanning software development, product backlogs, UI/UX design systems, BI analytics, digital marketing campaigns, and IT operations.

● Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, roadmap development, and technical requirement intake.

● Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience synthesizing technical details into clear executive updates.

● Strong documentation discipline, with proven capability crafting project plans, decision logs, SOPs, and workflow diagrams.

● Must be proactive, detail\-oriented, and resourceful, capable of bringing order to complex initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.

*Preferred*

● Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent certification.

● Prior experience in real estate platforms, multi\-brand digital environments, e\-commerce, or SaaS technology operations.

● Experience managing a blended bench of full\-time employees and remote contractors across multiple U.S. time zones.

● Familiarity with modern technology stack workflows, data warehousing, CRM integrations (e.g., HubSpot), and AI\-assisted workflow tooling.

Pay: $42\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 32\.0 – 38\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/.



Application password: Niner

**Team (Project) Introduction**



We are recruiting for a range of cybersecurity opportunities supporting federal customers, focused on strengthening enterprise security architecture, systems engineering, and the secure implementation of technologies across the environment.



The work involves applying established cybersecurity standards, guidelines, and frameworks to help translate organizational and business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions. Team members may contribute to security architecture and engineering efforts, implementation guidance, technical analysis, and the development of repeatable approaches that support the consistent deployment and operation of secure technologies across complex enterprise environments.



Systems security engineering is an important component of this work, with an emphasis on incorporating security and stakeholder protection requirements throughout the system development life cycle, from concept and design through development, production, sustainment, and decommissioning. The team will apply established systems engineering and cybersecurity principles to help protect systems, applications, data, and supporting technologies.



Ultimately, this work supports the broader mission to strengthen its cybersecurity posture, reduce organizational risk, and protect critical systems and information from evolving cyber threats, including external adversaries and insider threats.

jobs.title: EverCommerce Payments - Senior Project Manager (Remote US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/


Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


We are seeking a highly proactive Senior Project Manager to join the EverCommerce Payments PMO. This organization is focused on delivering unparalleled value to our customers through frictionless embedded payments and commerce solutions at scale. You will play a key role delivering projects to drive scalable growth across the EverCommerce Solution Organizations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, takes extreme ownership of complex initiatives, and confidently drives cross\-functional teams toward successful delivery. You will lead high\-visibility payment initiatives spanning product, engineering, operations, customer success, and executive leadership while ensuring projects remain on track and stakeholders remain accountable.


**Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the single point of accountability for multiple strategic payment initiatives from initiation through successful delivery.
* Drive accountability with cross\-functional teams, ensuring commitments are met regardless of organizational level or reporting structure.
* Identify project risks early, proactively remove blockers, and escalate issues with mitigation plans and recommended solutions.
* Lead executive\-level status meetings with confidence, providing concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps.
* Maintain complete ownership of project plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items.
* Build scalable project governance through clear plans, transparent reporting, proactive risk management, and actionable executive communications.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead project retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement changes as necessary.

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**


* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, related field and/or PMP is preferred
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in project management
* Experience delivering complex payment processing, merchant onboarding, or embedded payment integrations is strongly preferred
* Advanced proficiency with Asana is required. Candidate should have experience building project plans, managing dependencies, dashboards, reporting, automations, portfolios, and executive reporting
* Comfortable presenting to Directors, Vice Presidents, and executive leadership while facilitating difficult conversations, resolving conflicts, and driving decisions.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and create structure where one does not yet exist.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives in a rapidly changing environment.
* Demonstrated history of successfully delivering multiple complex, cross\-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

**Where:** This is a remote, US based position, some travel required for quarterly events and on\-sight partner meetings. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


**Benefits and Perks**


* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid
* Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program

**Compensation****:** The target base compensation for this position is $100,000 to $110,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Please refer to our Compensation section below to see what neighborhoods fall under each Zone.


### **Role Description**


Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager, Customers to build the connective layer between EPD and GTM as we test products, evolve the platform, and learn from our managed customer base. This role will plan, recruit, launch, engage, measure, and close out customer programs while maintaining clear product\-readiness standards and a strong customer experience.


The role is execution\-focused but broad in scope. The immediate priority is creating a scalable way to test pre\-PMF products with existing managed customers, including priority programs. Over time, the role will support additional customer\-facing EPD initiatives, help relaunch and operate Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board, integrate customer testing into launch processes, and establish repeatable playbooks that can be adopted by functional owners.


You will work closely with Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics. You will have substantial cross\-functional exposure and the opportunity to turn customer participation into clearer product decisions, stronger launch readiness, and a closed insight loop back into product and GTM.


### **Responsibilities**


* Stand up and run repeatable customer programs, including planning, recruitment, onboarding, engagement, measurement, closeout, and transition to the long\-term owning team.
* Create shared operating infrastructure, including intake processes, recruitment and readiness criteria, briefs, templates, playbooks, status reporting, feedback tracking, escalation paths, and a single source of truth.
* Coordinate Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics around shared plans, decisions, milestones, and handoffs.
* Own the execution of pre\-PMF customer testing through H2, including product evaluation, messaging feedback, phased\-rollout support, measurement, and exit criteria.
* Support the relaunch and ongoing operation of Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board through recruitment, cadence management, agenda design, and synthesis for senior leaders and partner teams.
* Integrate customer testing into the product\-launch process as a readiness gate or stage, partnering with PMM and Launch Ops as the process matures.
* Establish recurring customer listening and insight\-loop practices that connect customer\-support signals, VoC, UXR, managed\-customer feedback, and S\-team engagement back into EPD and GTM decision\-making.

### **Requirements**


* 8\+ years of program management, operations, customer research operations, product operations, go\-to\-market operations, or a related field with experience delivering complex cross\-functional programs.
* Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer\-facing initiative from planning through execution, measurement, closeout, and handoff.
* Experience coordinating multiple teams with different goals, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining clear ownership and follow\-through.
* Strong operating discipline: able to create practical processes, readiness criteria, documentation, reporting rhythms, and repeatable playbooks.
* Experience working directly with customers or customer\-facing teams, including recruiting participants, managing engagement, gathering feedback, and protecting customer experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Sound judgment about product readiness, customer participation, confidentiality, escalation, and when to protect learning quality over premature storytelling or account\-driven requests.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with pre\-PMF product testing, beta or Design Partner programs, Customer Advisory Boards, Voice of Customer, user research operations, or customer advocacy programs.
* Experience embedding customer feedback or testing into product\-launch, launch\-readiness, or product\-operations processes.
* Experience building a program that scales across products, customer segments, or launch types and then transitioning it to a durable functional owner.
* Experience in a SaaS, collaboration, productivity, platform, or enterprise software environment.
* Familiarity with customer insight systems, feedback taxonomies, program dashboards, or tools used to track participant health and product signal.

### **Durable Skills**


AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:


* **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others.
* **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
* **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
* **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

  

  

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.

Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.

Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.

**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

**Job Description**


The Program Manager, Academics supports the implementation and continuous improvement of K12's portfolio\-wide academic strategy. Working closely with the Director, Academic Strategy, this role translates strategic priorities into effective processes, tools, resources, communications, and supports that help schools strengthen academic practice and student outcomes.  

The Program Manager plays a key role in managing the K12 School Playbook process, analyzing implementation and performance information, identifying trends and effective practices across schools, and supporting the development and adoption of scalable academic solutions. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong academic knowledge, analytical thinking, project management, and the ability to coordinate complex work across teams and schools.**Essential Functions:** Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

* Support implementation of K12's academic strategy by translating priorities into plans, processes, tools, resources, and school\-facing supports.
* Manage key components of the annual K12 School Playbook process, including timelines, templates, guidance, communications, review workflows, documentation, and follow\-up.
* Support review of school Playbooks to promote quality, coherence, and alignment with K12 expectations.
* Coordinate the Playbook review and feedback process, track required revisions and emerging themes, and support consistent application of established quality standards.
* Analyze Playbooks, implementation evidence, academic performance, engagement, graduation, and accountability data to identify common strengths, challenges, and opportunities across schools.
* Synthesize findings across schools and help identify, document, and share effective and evidence\-informed practices that can be scaled across the portfolio.
* Develop and maintain academic frameworks, implementation guides, tools, exemplars, resources, and other materials that support strong Tier 1 academic practices and consistent execution.
* Support implementation and monitoring of academic initiatives, identify implementation barriers, and recommend adjustments based on data and school feedback.
* Partner with school and portfolio leaders to gather feedback, understand implementation needs, and support effective adoption of academic priorities and practices.
* Develop and coordinate professional learning, communications, and resources related to academic strategy, the School Playbook, and priority academic practices.
* Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination for assigned academic initiatives.
* Collaborate with Accountability, Assessment, Research, Curriculum and Instruction, School Services, Transformation, Special Programs, School Counseling, Career Readiness, and other teams to support aligned implementation.
* Prepare analyses, summaries, presentations, and recommendations for the Director, Academic Strategy and other leaders related to academic performance, Playbook implementation, emerging trends, and strategic initiatives.
* Support continuous improvement by monitoring implementation and outcomes, gathering stakeholder feedback, and recommending improvements to academic processes, tools, and supports.

 **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

* Bachelor's degree in education, curriculum and instruction, educational leadership, or a related field.
* Five (5\) or more years of related experience in K–12 education, instructional leadership, academic programs, school support, project or program management, or a related field; OR
* Equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience using academic or student performance data to identify trends and support decision\-making.

**Certificates and Licenses**: None required.

* Strong understanding of effective K–12 instructional practices and systems supporting student academic success.

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain quality and consistency across complex processes and deliverables.

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.  

Goldbelt Glacier is a trusted industry partner to the Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). jobs.title: Supervisor, Transitions of Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


We want to help patients navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way, feel their best, and better manage their chronic diseases. Our transitions of care program is critical to achieving these goals, and TOC Coordinators will play a key role in supporting these programs.


As the supervisor for the TOC Coordinators, you'll lead a team of TOC Coordinators in serving as advocates for these patients, supporting the TOC clinical team. The goal is to ensure the patients have the necessary resources and support to transition to home from the hospital and/or post acute setting and prevent re\-admissions.


The supervisor will manage a team of TOC Coordinators and guide their work to take care of patients during the transition of care episode: connecting with patients; enabling ancillary services like appointments, transportation, supplies, and durable medical equipment; and follow\-up communication.The TOC supervisor is an integral part of the TOC team, and will be heavily involved in the day to day team operations, as well as being an active participant in rounds/huddles. The supervisor will provide support to the team, develop new workflows and job aids, coach and manage performance, and attend and/or facilitate regular meetings with team patients and leadership as required.

***Responsibilities will include :***

* 30% of the time will be dedicated to providing TOC patient care. Time spent on clinical responsibilities will fluctuate depending on the number of direct reports.
* Assists as needed with monitoring team attendance and adherence and participation in meetings/forums
* Collaborating with leadership in TOC to help develop the program
* Join cross functional meetings to represent TOC coordination and share relevant updates with the larger team
* May be assigned additional responsibilities as the TOC care model evolves
* Assist in recruiting and hiring process of new TOC Coordinators
* Participate and coordinate TOC Coordinators involved in TOC clinical model pilots
* Partner with the TOC trainer and DM education team in onboarding new TOC Coordinators
* Manage TOC coordinator performance across array of key performance indicators
* Provide oversight and support to the TOC Coordinators by answering questions, monitoring relevant slack channels and conducting 1:1s
* Process improvement: assist in design, \& implementation of new workflows, including job aid creation and facilitating training
* Meets with Senior Manager regularly to go over team performance and make recommendations for improvement

***Required skills and experience:***

* MA Certification (desired), expired MA certifications are OK! \[Verification: A copy of your active or expired certification will be required. No Certification: If you have significant MA experience/background, we may request copies of your MA school diploma and transcripts.]
* 2 years of direct lead or supervisory experience in a virtual setting required

***Desired skills and experience:***

* 2\+ years healthcare administrative/office experience Proficient in technology using evolving platforms
* A history of being organized and having high attention to detail \- it’s the little things that matter
* Fully bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required

***Salary Range:*** $58,000 \- $82,000 / year


The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.
