jobs.description:
**FIND YOUR FUTURE**
====================


We're excited about the potential people bring to our organization. You can grow your career here while enjoying first\-class perks, benefits and a culture that fosters growth, innovation and collaboration.

**Overview**
============


The Case Manager will be responsible for applying the six essential activities of case management which include assessment, planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation with the core components through the administration of quality improvement functions (process, relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery and psychosocial intervention).

**Qualifications**
==================

* Registered Nurse (RN) with active, current, unrestricted license in a Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) state required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Case Management Certification (CCM) required. Candidates without CCM certification are required to obtain it within three (3\) years of commencing employment.
* Three (3\) years of clinical RN experience in a med/surg or ambulatory care setting required. Clinical experience in at least one of the following areas preferred: Behavior Health, Transplant, Neo\-Natal or Oncology.
* Previous experience in managed care a plus.
* Clinical knowledge of the health or social work needs for the population served.
* Ability to identify barriers to a successful care management path.
* Ability to interact effectively with physicians and other members of the health care team.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, coupled with solid time management skills.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Transferable knowledge, skill and ability to complete job duties independently and proficiently. Flexibility in work schedules and assignments.
* Proven examples of displaying Nova’s Core 4: Act with Passion, Work Together, Be Accountable, Build Trust.

**Essential Accountabilities**
==============================

* Assess the patient’s broad spectrum of immediate and long\-term needs through evaluation of the patient’s social and medical history.
* Develop a plan of care based upon the patient and providers of care clinical assessments, considering physical and psychosocial needs, the benefit plan and cost benefit analysis factors which impact the patient’s optimal recovery.
* Continuously evaluate the plan of care within the scope of case management practice based on the changing needs of the patient and monitor the quality of care and effectiveness of care being provided for all involved members of the inter disciplinary team.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and privacy standards, prompt payment/reimbursement and appeal process as indicated; coordinate the decision and documentation process; maintain a current and accurate database.
* Establish professional working relationships with all members of the interdisciplinary team and communicate case objectives to the appropriate involved parties.
* Act as a patient advocate understanding and identifying potential for complications, understanding methods for assessing the current and future physical and psychosocial characteristics of illnesses.
* Read, understand and apply principals of the American with Disabilities Act and understand federal legislation affecting individuals with disabilities.
* Be knowledgeable of assistive and adaptive equipment.
* Establish available support systems and be versed in methods of researching and interviewing community resources to assist the patient in achieving maximum psychological, social and physical recovery.
* Effectively communicate to the patient the available services and resources applicable to the patient’s immediate and future needs. Assist the patient in obtaining these services.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative care through assessment and evaluation of the patient’s needs, as well as available resources.
* Work closely with the payor, providers and all involved team members in evaluating the quality and cost effectiveness of services. Negotiate cost discounts when appropriate.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative levels of care and resources (i.e. rehabilitation facilities and home health care providers). Implement alternatives to existing care, considering quality of care and the patient’s current and ongoing needs.
* Understand case management concepts such as roles, philosophies, principles, liability and confidentiality issues. Apply these concepts in developing appropriate plan of care and goals based on the needs of the patient.
* Be knowledgeable in applying problem solving techniques to the case management process. Analyze and evaluate outcomes and implement alternatives when appropriate.
* Document the patient’s plan of care in a timely manner.
* Maintain professional status within the community through membership in professional organizations and/or participation in continuing education.
* Participate in Nova’s training and education committees as assigned. Provide input into support staff orientation and training as it relates to the Case Manager’s role.
* Provide support, guidance, and direction to support staff as indicated.
* Perform all assignments in a professional manner.
* Be knowledgeable of the scope of practice of their multi\-state licensure and practice accordingly.

jobs.description:
**About Blackbird Health**



Blackbird Health is clinician\-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in\-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, and New Jersey—and we're growing into new markets in 2026\.



At Blackbird, we take a whole\-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you'll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that's shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you're passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.



Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

**Position Summary**



Blackbird Health is expanding rapidly, and we are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resilient **Clinical Operations Specialist** to join our Medical Services (MS) or Behavioral Health (BHD) Teams. This role is designed for a system\-minded professional who takes pride in supporting operational excellence. You will directly own the infrastructure of our day\-to\-day clinical services teams, mastering complex scheduling, architecting solutions for real\-time calendar changes, and managing non\-clinical patient touchpoints. You aren't just assisting a team; you are actively supporting the management of the clinical engine that ensures our patients get timely access to care and our providers experience a predictable, sustainable workday.



As a vital link between patients, providers, and leadership, you will manage day\-to\-day scheduling workflows, own the provider call\-out and PTO calendars, handle non\-clinical patient requests, and compile data reporting to help our leadership scale. This is a fully non\-clinical, high\-impact operational support role perfect for a self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves building order out of chaos. This is a fully remote role.


**What Makes You, You:**


* **You are a logistics puzzle master.** Managing complex calendars, sudden call\-outs, and shifting schedules doesn't stress you out—it energizes you.
* **You possess radical empathy and a calm demeanor.** Whether you are answering a busy medication refill line, routing a non\-clinical crisis, or handling a patient complaint, you listen deeply and remain completely unflustered.
* **You are fiercely organized.** You naturally track deadlines, monitor metrics, update data systems meticulously, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* **You are an analytical helper.** You don't just collect data; you enjoy formatting and organizing it into clean, readable reports that make it easy for Directors and VPs to make decisions.
* **You thrive in an environment of autonomy.** You enjoy working in flat structures where you report directly to a Director, and you don't need constant hand\-holding to solve routine administrative problems.


**How You'll Make an Impact:**


* **Provider Attendance Ownership:** Manage day\-to\-day scheduling, rescheduling, and PTO tracking. Serve as the central air traffic control for unexpected provider call\-outs, ensuring immediate schedule coverage and system adjustments.
* **Patient Advocacy \& Issue Intake:** Act as the first line of defense for non\-clinical patient complaints, logging tracking data, and routing non\-clinical crises to appropriate leaders seamlessly.

**Customer Success Manager**


**OUR COMPANY**


SimX is a fast\-growing company bringing virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional\-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors.


Since our product became generally available, demand has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation's top 15 hospitals, including world\-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania. Additionally, our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military bases. We are looking for a mission\-driven leader to help us continue this momentum and save lives through better training.


**THE JOB**


The Customer Success Manager owns a portfolio of customers and is responsible for onboarding, retention, expansion, and long\-term adoption of SimX's platform. We are looking for a collaborative and highly engaged Customer Success Manager to drive revenue growth across a set of existing customers while looking for ways to enhance the customer journey post\-sale. If you are a strong communicator \& negotiator, have an ownership mindset, and enjoy building relationships with your customers, then we invite you to apply.


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


### **Customer Relationship \& Success**


* **Trusted Partnership**: Develop deep, trusted relationships within accounts to serve as a primary point of contact and advisor.
* **Success Planning**: Partner with customers to define clear success criteria and conduct regular "Business Reviews" to ensure their goals are being met.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**: Work closely with Educational Services to develop account strategies and ensure a seamless experience across the customer journey.


### **Product \& Technical Expertise**


* **Technical Onboarding:** Lead comprehensive virtual and in\-person onboarding, training (including VR hardware/software setup), and refresher sessions for new and key clients.
* **Roadmap Alignment**: Support and drive customer understanding of the SimX product roadmap, recommending creative ways to maximize product utilization.
* **Cross\-Department Collaboration:** Work with the customer support and educational services team to provide prompt, thorough support to clients during onboarding, and attend/support critical in\-person training events and exercises.


### **Sales \& Revenue Strategy**


* **Ownership of the Post\-Sale Journey**: Own, drive, and manage the complete customer journey from onboarding to renewal to ensure high retention and satisfaction.
* **Revenue Growth**: Drive retention and expansion within your accounts through strong adoption, value realization, and strategic account planning.
* **Risk Mitigation**: Proactively maintain the book of business, identifying and communicating any retention risks to internal resources to develop effective resolution strategies.
* **Commercial Management**: Lead multiple customer touchpoints by engaging key stakeholders and managing the commercial aspects of the account.


### **Operations \& Reporting**


* **Process Improvement**: Assist in developing and improving internal processes to make the post\-sale team more effective and efficient.
* **Data Integrity**: Manage, track, and report all sales and success activities using Salesforce to ensure accurate data for the organization.
* **Usage Tracking:** Track monthly usage of customers, identify high\-use and low\-use customers, and develop strategies in partnership with Educational Services for driving greater platform adoption and utilization.


**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**


* 2 \- 4 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar customer\-facing role within SaaS or similar.
* Strong track record of managing a book of business with retention and/or expansion targets
* Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce or equivalent) as well as office software like Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Consultative selling experience resulting in growing existing accounts
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Proof of eligibility to work in the United States

jobs.title: Lab Visit Support Lead
jobs.description:
US \- Remote

### **About Us**

  

  

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

### **The Role**

  

  

We are seeking a **Lab Visit Support Lead** to own the day\-to\-day operations and performance of an LVS team (“POD”) of approximately 10 Member Support Agents. This role sits at the center of frontline execution: ensuring work is prioritized effectively, staffing and workflows are adjusted in real time, escalations are resolved quickly, and the team consistently delivers a high\-quality member experience.  

  

Lab Visit Support (LVS) is the team responsible for providing real\-time support to Function members on the day of their lab visit, whether at a Quest location or during a mobile phlebotomy appointment. The team handles whatever comes up to keep visits on track—from check\-in and Quest navigation issues to same\-day lab order corrections, add\-on tests, scheduling changes, cancellations, test preparation questions, and system outages—all while managing live inboxes and phone lines in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

The LVS Lead is both an **operational leader and people manager**. You will directly manage MSAs and Senior MSAs, providing real\-time coaching, performance feedback, development, and accountability while ensuring the team meets its daily operational goals. You’ll empower Senior MSAs to serve as frontline resources while stepping in on complex escalations, critical errors, or situations requiring leadership judgment.  

  

You will work in close partnership with the LVS Manager, serving as their primary source of visibility into frontline performance, emerging trends, and operational friction. While the Manager focuses on longer\-term strategy, workforce planning, performance trends, and scalable improvements, the Lead owns the **daily execution and decisions that keep the team performing at a high level today**.  

  

*Given that Lab Visit Support operates Monday–Sunday across multiple time zones, this role will periodically require weekend and/or holiday on\-call coverage on a rotating schedule with other leaders.*  

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

  

  

* **Lead Day\-to\-Day Operations:** Own real\-time execution for your Lab Visit Support POD, ensuring work is prioritized, delegated, and completed effectively while stepping in to resolve high\-impact issues and escalations.
* **Manage \& Develop the Team:** Directly manage MSAs and Senior MSAs, providing ongoing coaching, feedback, performance management, and development while fostering a culture of accountability and growth.
* **Drive Team Performance:** Monitor productivity, quality, adherence, and other key performance indicators, identifying performance gaps and taking action to ensure the team consistently meets expectations.
* **Own Real\-Time Staffing \& Scheduling:** Manage day\-to\-day staffing and workload allocation, including schedules, coverage, overtime, time off, and adjustments based on changing member demand.
* **Ensure Quality \& Operational Excellence:** Partner with Senior MSAs to maintain high quality standards, address critical errors and recurring coaching themes, and ensure consistent adherence to established processes.
* **Lead Escalation Management:** Serve as the leadership point of contact for complex or high\-priority member and operational escalations, supporting Senior MSAs and making timely decisions to keep lab visits on track.
* **Support Onboarding \& Training:** Oversee the onboarding and ramp of new team members, partnering with Senior MSAs to ensure new hires develop the knowledge, judgment, and confidence needed to operate independently.
* **Identify \& Drive Improvements:** Surface trends, workflow inefficiencies, documentation gaps, and tooling opportunities, owning day\-to\-day improvements and partnering with the Manager on broader operational initiatives.
* **Partner Cross\-Functionally:** Collaborate with teams across Member Experience and Operations to investigate issues, improve workflows, and ensure a seamless member experience.
* **Provide Operational Insights:** Maintain close partnership with the LVS Manager, surfacing frontline performance, staffing, quality, and member\-experience insights that inform broader workforce planning and team strategy.
* **Build Team Culture:** Lead regular team touchpoints and create an environment of strong communication, collaboration, accountability, and connection to Function’s mission.

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high\-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

The Account Manager is responsible for growing the agency's work with its existing clients, building and maintaining long\-term client relationships, and managing the commercial side of each account, including contracts and invoicing. new_jobs.title: Product Operations Manager, Model Quality
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Operations Manager to join our Product Operations Foundations team and drive model quality across all Meta surfaces. We are in the middle of a transformation, becoming an AI\-driven, IC\-led organization that scales through orchestration, deep product expertise, and technical excellence. Our team is building and operating autonomous agents that handle end\-to\-end workflows (triage, bug resolution, launches, dogfooding, evals) with minimal human intervention. If you're energized by owning complex quality programs end\-to\-end, building and operating AI\-driven workflows, and driving measurable product improvements in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you. You will be responsible for managing and evaluating our AI solutions and infrastructure to improve precision, prevent drift, and maintain real\-time observability. This role is expected to set strategy for LLM models, determine areas of investment for increasing accuracy, advise leadership on impending risks, define roadmaps and reporting strategy to shape the future of our AI work. As part of this work, you will be expected to build and maintain industry\-wide expertise, develop effective cross\-functional relationships, advise engineering and cross\-functional partners on areas of investment, determine staffing needs, and solution against critical bottlenecks.  

  

  

### **Product Operations Manager, Model Quality Responsibilities:**

* Defines the technical direction for model maintenance (retraining cadences, drift mitigation, performance recovery) and evolution (new capabilities, architecture improvements, multi\-modal expansion). Translates cross\-product performance patterns into investment recommendations for evaluation leads
* Provides cross\-product context, defines what good looks like at the model level, and informs evaluation methodology. Evals owners own execution of verification pipelines within their products
* this role ensures consistency and identifies gaps across the portfolio while building institutional competence by surfacing performance patterns and proven methodologies, enabling evals captains' ability to execute and unblocking them as needed
* Defines what leadership needs to see, how model health should be measured and reported, and what thresholds trigger escalation
* Provides thought partnership to evals managers on narrative of model health, provides visibility into our classification strategy and accuracy measurement process
* Works with evaluation managers to drive cross\-app taxonomy alignment in alignment with cross\-functional needs and advises on a strategy for the migration of LLM accuracy assessment to judges
* Owns the consolidated view of all production model performance, identifies systemic patterns and emerging risks, and ensures leadership can verify model health on demand
* Partners with AI Implementations, operational systems teams and the Metrics \& Measurement team to build and maintain the infrastructure that surfaces this information
* Establishes performance guardrails that evals captains implement. Continuously scans industry developments and best practices to incorporate into org\-wide approach
* Maintains a tight feedback loop with product and eng teams across apps to ensure alignment on production priorities and deployment risks
* Deploys deep SME expertise to diagnose, unblock and directly resolve technical bottlenecks to complex model quality problems (atrophy, accuracy regressions, performance plateaus) when evaluation leads encounter blockers they cannot resolve independently
* Drives alignment with cross\-functional teams (quality and reliability partner teams) on tooling needs to support Product Operations classification strategy (ML classification tooling for initial\-tier classification, user voice, breakdown graphs). Advocates for investment, flags risks, influences direction

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or data analysis
* Analytical experience using data to tell a story and influence product direction using intermediate to advanced SQL
* Experience building or deploying AI/ML solutions, LLM model quality or automation in production workflows
* Strong communication skills with ability to influence multiple cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership
* Experience breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop solutions
* Ability to design AI workflows that operate effectively within enterprise data sensitivity constraints, balancing quality and privacy principles

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience operating in flat, IC\-heavy org structures with high individual autonomy
* Demonstrated history of evaluating industry best practices and providing organizational recommendations on approaches to AI models and development
* Experience in product quality, QA, or technical program management
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or ML evaluation frameworks

new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Operations Manager to join our Product Operations Foundations team and drive model quality across all Meta surfaces. We are in the middle of a transformation, becoming an AI\-driven, IC\-led organization that scales through orchestration, deep product expertise, and technical excellence. Our team is building and operating autonomous agents that handle end\-to\-end workflows (triage, bug resolution, launches, dogfooding, evals) with minimal human intervention. If you're energized by owning complex quality programs end\-to\-end, building and operating AI\-driven workflows, and driving measurable product improvements in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you. You will be responsible for managing and evaluating our AI solutions and infrastructure to improve precision, prevent drift, and maintain real\-time observability. This role is expected to set strategy for LLM models, determine areas of investment for increasing accuracy, advise leadership on impending risks, define roadmaps and reporting strategy to shape the future of our AI work. As part of this work, you will be expected to build and maintain industry\-wide expertise, develop effective cross\-functional relationships, advise engineering and cross\-functional partners on areas of investment, determine staffing needs, and solution against critical bottlenecks.  

  

  

### **Product Operations Manager, Model Quality Responsibilities:**

* Defines the technical direction for model maintenance (retraining cadences, drift mitigation, performance recovery) and evolution (new capabilities, architecture improvements, multi\-modal expansion). Translates cross\-product performance patterns into investment recommendations for evaluation leads
* Provides cross\-product context, defines what good looks like at the model level, and informs evaluation methodology. Evals owners own execution of verification pipelines within their products
* this role ensures consistency and identifies gaps across the portfolio while building institutional competence by surfacing performance patterns and proven methodologies, enabling evals captains' ability to execute and unblocking them as needed

* Partners with AI Implementations, operational systems teams and the Metrics \& Measurement team to build and maintain the infrastructure that surfaces this information
* Establishes performance guardrails that evals captains implement. Continuously scans industry developments and best practices to incorporate into org\-wide approach
* Maintains a tight feedback loop with product and eng teams across apps to ensure alignment on production priorities and deployment risks
* Deploys deep SME expertise to diagnose, unblock and directly resolve technical bottlenecks to complex model quality problems (atrophy, accuracy regressions, performance plateaus) when evaluation leads encounter blockers they cannot resolve independently

Advocates for investment, flags risks, influences direction

**Join our team!**


At Sonesta Oyster Point San Francisco, we are committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences through outstanding service, operational excellence, and a culture of hospitality. We are seeking an experience and motived Operational Manager to oversee our Housekeeping and Maintenance operations while supporting the General Manager in driving overall hotel performance.


This leadership position is responsible for ensuring the hotel's physical condition, cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who thrives in a fast\-paced hospitality environment and is passionate about team development, asset protection, and operational efficiency.

**Position Summary**


The operational Manager oversees the daily operations of the Housekeeping and Maintenance departments, ensuring the hotel maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and functionality, This role is responsible for protecting hotel assets through preventive maintenance, leading high performing teams, and supporting guest satisfaction initiatives.


The Operations Manager champions WS Management's commitment to Outrageous Hospitality, core values, and the three P Philosophy:

**People:** Support and develop team members through effective leadership and coaching.

**Planet:** Promote sustainable and efficient operational practices

**Profit:** Protect hotel assets and optimize labor and operational expenses.


This position serves as a Manager\-On\-Duty and may act as the General Manager's representative when necessary.

**Key responsibilities**

**Housekeeping LeadershipQuality Assurance**

Oversee daily housekeeping operations, room readiness, inspections, and cleaning standards.


Ensure all guest rooms, public areas, and back\-of\-house spaces meet or exceed brand standards


Manage scheduling staffing levels, training, coaching, and performance management for Housekeeping team members.


Partner closely with Front Desk leadership to ensure room status accuracy and efficient room turnover.


Conduct regular quality inspections and implement corrective action plans when neccessary.

**MaintenanceAsset Management**


Lead preventative maintenance programs and ensure timely completion of work orders.


Maintain building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life\-safety equipment


Perform regular property inspections to identify maintenance, safety, and appearance concerns.


Coordinate vender services, repairs, and approval capital improvement projects


Protect hotel assets through proactive maintenance and repair planning

**Safety, ComplianceRisk Mangement**


Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and fire\-life\-safety standards


Oversee proper chemical handling, MSDS compliance, and equipment safety procedures,


Maintain accurate inspection records, logs, and compliance documentation


Respond professionally and effectively to emergencies and operational incidents


Promote a culture of workplace safety and accountability

**Qualifications**


Minimum 3 years of hotel operations, housekeeping, maintenance, or facilities management leadership experience


Proven experience leading and developing teams in a hospitality environment


Strong understanding of hotel operations, cleanliness standards, and preventative maintenance programs.


Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems


Experience managing labor costs, departmental budgets, and inventory controls


Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills


Proficiency with hotel property management systems and Microsoft Office applications


Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.


This statement listed are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be all responsibilities or qualifications of the job. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, employees may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and make employment decisions without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, gender, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other protected class. Those who are ineligible to work in the United States will not be considered.

**Full\-Time \| In Person**

Lead Operations for One of Silicon Valley’s Top Luxury Real Estate Brokerages

Keller Williams Bay Area Estates (KWBAE) is the **\#1 most profitable Keller Williams real estate brokerage year\-to\-date in the Northern California \& Hawaii Region** and one of Silicon Valley’s leading luxury real estate brokerages.

We are looking for an experienced operational leader who wants to make a meaningful impact on a successful, growing organization.

About the Position

We are seeking a hands\-on **Operations Manager / Market Center Administrator (MCA)** to join our brokerage leadership team and help drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

This role oversees financial and operational systems, leads onsite and virtual staff, and partners closely with senior and executive leadership on budgeting, forecasting, profitability, strategic planning, business development, sponsorships, and company\-wide growth initiatives.

* Coordinate vendors, contractors, consultants, and outside service providers

* Lead through influence as well as direct authority
* Anticipate and resolve problems with urgency, diplomacy, and sound judgment
* Step in personally when business or staffing needs require it

**Financial Management and Profitability**

* Participate in budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and business planning

* Ensure financial and operational reporting is accurate, complete, and timely
* Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved
* Identify inefficiencies, unnecessary expenses, and opportunities to improve profitability
* Provide analysis and recommendations that support executive decision\-making
* Help ensure the brokerage remains profitable and financially disciplined as it grows

**Systems, Technology, and Execution**

* Turn executive priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurements
* Own the implementation, adoption, and ongoing use of **Trainual**
* Build and maintain SOPs, training materials, workflows, and backup coverage
* Use **Todoist** to manage projects, responsibilities, deadlines, and accountability
* Lead new systems and processes from setup through rollout, training, adoption, and follow\-through
* Use technology, automation, and AI to improve efficiency and scalability
* Ensure initiatives are implemented and used—not simply discussed

**Executive Leadership and Growth**

* Serve as a trusted operational partner to senior and executive leadership
* Participate in company planning, operational strategy, and growth initiatives
* Support agent recruiting, retention, engagement, and production programs
* Ensure the company has the staffing, systems, training, and operational capacity required for growth
* Track company goals and provide clear progress reporting
* Identify operational obstacles and bring forward practical solutions
* Support business\-development initiatives, strategic partnerships, and sponsorship opportunities
* Help leadership evaluate new programs, investments, partnerships, and growth opportunities

* Evaluate the environment through the eyes of agents, recruits, clients, and guests
* Maintain high standards for presentation, organization, service, and professionalism
* Proactively identify and correct office issues before leadership needs to point them out
* Delegate office\-readiness responsibilities and verify completion

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Housing Element Services
new_jobs.description:
BKF is a multi\-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.


At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.


The Project Manager – Housing Element Services leads project delivery and business development for Housing Element work within the Community Planning practice. This role reports to the Community Planning Practice Lead and is responsible for driving the firm’s growth in 7th cycle Housing Element updates and implementation, building on a track record of 6th cycle delivery. The Project Manager should have hands\-on experience managing Housing Element updates from background analysis through HCD certification, along with a working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and affirmatively furthering fair housing (AFFH) analysis.


This is a seller\-doer role. The Project Manager will manage a portfolio of Housing Element projects while also leading the identification, pursuit, and capture of new 7th cycle opportunities, working closely with the Practice Lead on pipeline strategy and proposal development.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Delivery:**

* Serve as Project Manager on Housing Element update and implementation projects, including background reports, site inventories, program development, rezoning, and public engagement through HCD certification.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and subconsultant coordination to ensure quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Guide clients through HCD review cycles and evolving state housing law requirements.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary internal teams across planning, environmental, and engineering disciplines.

**Business Development \& Pursuit Leadership:**

* Lead the firm’s strategy for identifying and pursuing 7th cycle Housing Element opportunities, with a focus on the Bay Area and LA metro markets.
* Track upcoming Housing Element RFP releases and position the firm ahead of key pursuits.
* Lead proposal development and RFP responses, partnering with the Practice Lead and Business Development team on go\-to\-market strategy.
* Build and maintain relationships with city and county planning staff, HCD, and housing stakeholders.
* Contribute to the achievement of overall Planning sector sales and booking goals.

**Community Engagement:**

* Lead public outreach and engagement efforts for Housing Element updates, including community workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public hearings.
* Develop accessible outreach materials that clearly communicate housing policy and program concepts to diverse communities.
* Apply an equity lens to engagement strategy, consistent with AFFH requirements.

**Client Engagement:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for project clients, maintaining strong relationships and proactively addressing client needs.
* Represent the firm at local industry events, conferences, and public agency meetings.

**Collaboration \& Team Development:**

* Work collaboratively with the broader Community Planning team and other service lines, including Resiliency, Environmental Compliance, and Housing.
* Support mentorship and professional development of junior staff, with a path toward supervising direct reports as the Housing Element portfolio grows.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**  

* Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in community planning, with a focus on Housing Element preparation and implementation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as Project Manager or a lead team member on at least one 6th cycle (2021–2029\) Housing Element update.
* Working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and AFFH analysis.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to business development, including proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations; prior seller\-doer experience preferred.
* Strong community engagement skills, with experience facilitating public meetings and developing outreach materials.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex housing policy topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Remote/hybrid position; candidates established in the Bay Area or LA metro area are preferred.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support project sites, client meetings, and regional offices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Public Policy, or a closely related field is required.
* AICP certification is preferred.


Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.


Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high\-stress, fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

 **Benefits**  

* The typical base salary range for this position is $139,744\.8 \- $170,799\.2 annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.
* Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.
* Generous paid time off packages.
* 9 Paid Holidays.
* Flexible schedules.
* Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional

new_jobs.title: Operations Lead, Megapack
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Tesla is seeking a Development Operations Lead to serve as the operational backbone of Tesla Energy’s project development organization. This role will build the systems, processes, and workflows that enable the team to scale across solar, storage, and powered land projects.


The Operations Lead will own the team’s project management infrastructure — processes, budget tracking, vendor management, legal and contract coordination, and cross\-functional reporting. This person will ensure that nothing falls through the cracks as the pipeline grows, and will be a key enabler of the team’s speed and execution quality.


Successful candidates will have deep experience in renewable energy development operations and a builder’s mentality. We are seeking someone who thrives in ambiguity, can stand up processes from scratch, and has a passion for Tesla’s mission to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.

 **What You'll Do*** Design and implement the development team’s project management framework, including stage\-gate processes, milestone tracking, and go/no\-go decision workflows
* Own development budget tracking and reporting across the full portfolio, ensuring spend aligns with strategic priorities and capital allocation plans
* Manage vendor and consultant relationships (environmental, survey, legal, title) and negotiate master service agreements
* Coordinate land acquisition and legal workflows, including option agreements, lease negotiations, title/survey coordination, interconnection deposits, and permitting applications
* Build reporting dashboards and KPI frameworks to give leadership real\-time visibility into pipeline health, spend, and risk
* Develop and maintain internal knowledge management systems, templates, and playbooks for repeatable development processes
* Drive cross\-functional coordination between development, interconnection, origination, engineering, and finance workstreams
  

**What You'll Bring*** 5–12\+ years in renewable energy development operations, project management, or infrastructure project delivery
* Experience building or significantly scaling development operations at a utility\-scale solar, storage, or wind developer
* Strong proficiency in project management tools and experience building portfolio\-level tracking systems
* Experience managing development budgets across large portfolios ($25M\+ annual spend)
* Familiarity with the full renewable energy development lifecycle from site identification through NTP, including land, permitting, interconnection, and offtake milestones
* Experience with land acquisition workflows — option agreements, lease negotiations, title review, and closing processes
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Security Risk Program
new_jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Security Risk Program Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Meta's AI Launch Risk Assessment framework end to end — intake criteria, cross\-domain risk taxonomy, assessment methodology, and launch\-gate outputs — and scale delivery from \~5 to 20\+ assessments per quarter by H1 2027\.
* Build and partner to manage the XFN operating model that coordinates Central Security, product groups, Privacy Risk Management, Integrity Risk Management, and Legal through each assessment, with clear roles, handoffs, and decision rights on a launch timeline.
* Partner directly with product and engineering teams on high\-priority AI launches — engaging early enough that security risk review informs design decisions rather than gating release, and giving product teams a predictable, well\-documented path through second\-line review.

* Create and facilitate presentations that build senior leadership understanding and influence decision\-making, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on program design and assessment practice.

new_jobs.title: Landscape Project Coordinator: PT with Room for Advancement
new_jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

**Logistical Details**

**Part\-Time**: This position will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow to 20\+ hours per week as the role develops and the needs of the com

new_jobs.title: Member Support Specialist (Strawberry Village)
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**



One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn't your average doctor's office. We're on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved \- from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in\-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on\-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.



In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we're building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.


**The Opportunity**



As a Member Support Specialist (Administrative Assistant) you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in\-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.



You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer\-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self\-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.



What you'll likely work on:


* Use impeccable C\-I\-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in\-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary
* All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc
* Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.
* Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G\-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work
* Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization


These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.



What you'll need:


* At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback\-driven multi\-disciplinary teams
* A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges
* Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously
* Competitive salary: $24\.00 per hour


This is a full\-time role 40 hours per week (8 hour shifts per day) based in\-person with our team and patients at offices in Strawberry Village in Mill Valley from Monday\-Saturday between 7:30 AM and 6:00 PM PST. The base pay for this position is $24\.00 per hour based on a full time schedule, with a 1\.25 differential for eligible extended hours.



Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

**One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness. All regular team members working 24\+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:**



Taking care of you today


* Paid sabbatical for every five years of service
* Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family
* Employee Assistance Program \- Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues
* Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
* Pre\-Tax commuter benefits
* PTO cash outs \- Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year


Protecting your future for you and your family


* 401K match
* Credit towards emergency childcare
* Company paid maternity and paternity leave
* Paid Life Insurance \- One Medical pays 100%

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Bay Area


**Our Team:**

Semtech's commercial (sales) team is a high\-performing, strategic group driving Semtech's transformation into an industry\-leading demand generation organization. We recognize that our rep partners are strategic extensions of our go\-to\-market engine and critical force multipliers for reaching customers we can't serve directly. We thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment where tenacity, grit, and collaboration define our culture, measuring success by the trust we build with customers and partners, the innovative solutions we deliver together, and the market share we capture through disciplined execution.  



**Job Summary** **:**

The Strategic Account Manager is quota\-carrying regional sales position that will serve as a market share warrior, trusted customer advisor, and strategic partner orchestrator—driving explosive revenue growth through world\-class demand generation across direct accounts and rep\-covered territories. This high\-impact position combines strategic vision with competitive sales instincts, orchestrating complex deals while building best\-in\-class rep firm relationships that multiply market reach. You'll be part business strategist, part performance coach , part trusted advisor, and part market intelligence officer— leveraging deep customer intimacy and systematic rep enablement to outmaneuver competition.  



Your dual mandate spans the full Semtech portfolio: secure design wins with direct strategic accounts while building rep firm capability, alignment, and performance that amplifies your impact across territories. Success requires becoming a trusted advisor whom customers welcome into confidential discussions while creating strategic partnerships where rep firm success directly fuels Semtech's growth. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover business consequences and decision criteria driving customer choices, while coaching reps to do the same. Success will be measured by market share gains, customer and partner loyalty, design\-win velocity, and pipeline conversion at industry\-leading rates. * Track rep\-driven design\-win funnel progression and production ramp execution
* Develop rep capability through product training, technical solution selling coaching, and market intelligence sharing
* Monitor rep/distributor/direct commission conflicts and resolve using proof\-of\-influence methodology
* Build territory coverage strategies optimizing rep allocation and identifying underperforming coverage areas
* Track rep firm metrics including trip reports, opportunity quality, forecast accuracy, and customer engagement effectiveness
* Initiate performance improvement plans when rep firms fall below standards, making recommendations for rep changes when necessary
* Negotiate territory assignments, commission structures, and resource allocation based on ROI justification
Business Operations \& Forecasting

* Maintain Salesforce accuracy ensuring pipeline hygiene and data quality across direct and rep\-managed opportunities
* Prepare and present Opportunity Reviews, Account Plans, Pipeline Reviews, and Rep QBRs to leadership
* Track and report KPIs including design\-win count, revenue attainment, win/loss ratios, rep performance metrics, and customer satisfaction
* Develop account\-specific and territory\-wide pricing strategies balancing competitiveness with profitability

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. * Bachelor’s degree in management, construction management, engineering, quality, or related field or equivalent education and experience.

* Competent with computer programs (MS Office) and analytical tools.
* Ability to maintain an acceptable driving record.
* Up to 75% travel required.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Competitive pay and annual bonus
* Reimbursed lodging

* 100% employer\-paid health insurance premiums for employees
* 100% employer\-paid dental insurance premiums for everyone on plan
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Education assistance (tuition reimbursement)
* Employee/family focused culture
* And more!

Blattner Company is a leading renewable energy contractor and service provider with utility scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects across the United States. new_jobs.description:
**FIND YOUR FUTURE**
====================


We're excited about the potential people bring to our organization. You can grow your career here while enjoying first\-class perks, benefits and a culture that fosters growth, innovation and collaboration.

**Overview**
============


The Case Manager will be responsible for applying the six essential activities of case management which include assessment, planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation with the core components through the administration of quality improvement functions (process, relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery and psychosocial intervention).

**Qualifications**
==================

* Registered Nurse (RN) with active, current, unrestricted license in a Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) state required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Case Management Certification (CCM) required. Candidates without CCM certification are required to obtain it within three (3\) years of commencing employment.
* Three (3\) years of clinical RN experience in a med/surg or ambulatory care setting required. Clinical experience in at least one of the following areas preferred: Behavior Health, Transplant, Neo\-Natal or Oncology.
* Previous experience in managed care a plus.
* Clinical knowledge of the health or social work needs for the population served.
* Ability to identify barriers to a successful care management path.
* Ability to interact effectively with physicians and other members of the health care team.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, coupled with solid time management skills.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Transferable knowledge, skill and ability to complete job duties independently and proficiently. Flexibility in work schedules and assignments.
* Proven examples of displaying Nova’s Core 4: Act with Passion, Work Together, Be Accountable, Build Trust.

**Essential Accountabilities**
==============================

* Assess the patient’s broad spectrum of immediate and long\-term needs through evaluation of the patient’s social and medical history.
* Develop a plan of care based upon the patient and providers of care clinical assessments, considering physical and psychosocial needs, the benefit plan and cost benefit analysis factors which impact the patient’s optimal recovery.
* Continuously evaluate the plan of care within the scope of case management practice based on the changing needs of the patient and monitor the quality of care and effectiveness of care being provided for all involved members of the inter disciplinary team.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and privacy standards, prompt payment/reimbursement and appeal process as indicated; coordinate the decision and documentation process; maintain a current and accurate database.
* Establish professional working relationships with all members of the interdisciplinary team and communicate case objectives to the appropriate involved parties.
* Act as a patient advocate understanding and identifying potential for complications, understanding methods for assessing the current and future physical and psychosocial characteristics of illnesses.
* Read, understand and apply principals of the American with Disabilities Act and understand federal legislation affecting individuals with disabilities.
* Be knowledgeable of assistive and adaptive equipment.
* Establish available support systems and be versed in methods of researching and interviewing community resources to assist the patient in achieving maximum psychological, social and physical recovery.
* Effectively communicate to the patient the available services and resources applicable to the patient’s immediate and future needs. Assist the patient in obtaining these services.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative care through assessment and evaluation of the patient’s needs, as well as available resources.
* Work closely with the payor, providers and all involved team members in evaluating the quality and cost effectiveness of services. Negotiate cost discounts when appropriate.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative levels of care and resources (i.e. rehabilitation facilities and home health care providers). Implement alternatives to existing care, considering quality of care and the patient’s current and ongoing needs.
* Understand case management concepts such as roles, philosophies, principles, liability and confidentiality issues. Apply these concepts in developing appropriate plan of care and goals based on the needs of the patient.
* Be knowledgeable in applying problem solving techniques to the case management process. Analyze and evaluate outcomes and implement alternatives when appropriate.
* Document the patient’s plan of care in a timely manner.
* Maintain professional status within the community through membership in professional organizations and/or participation in continuing education.
* Participate in Nova’s training and education committees as assigned. Provide input into support staff orientation and training as it relates to the Case Manager’s role.
* Provide support, guidance, and direction to support staff as indicated.
* Perform all assignments in a professional manner.
* Be knowledgeable of the scope of practice of their multi\-state licensure and practice accordingly.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About By the Pixel**

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high\-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

We support our clients end\-to\-end: strategy, design, custom development, hosting, tiered production support, SEO, paid advertising, and content marketing. Most of what we build is engineered from scratch, because a one\-size\-fits\-all bundle rarely fits.

**How this role fits**

The Account Manager is responsible for growing the agency's work with its existing clients, building and maintaining long\-term client relationships, and managing the commercial side of each account, including contracts and invoicing. They also serve as the intake point for inbound leads, running first contact and discovery before new work is scoped.

**What you'll own**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Owns the long\-term relationship with each client, independent of any single project's lifecycle.
* Builds trust with decision\-makers and budget holders through a consistent cadence of meetings and check\-ins that sit above project status.
* Develops and maintains a deep understanding of each client's goals, challenges, budget cycles, and industry context.
* Serves as the escalation point for the account, handling client concerns and difficult conversations directly, responding promptly when the Project Manager raises something they cannot resolve on their own, and bringing in leadership when needed.
* Monitors account health and satisfaction, acting on early signs of friction or disengagement before they become churn risks.
* Leads client communication whenever a conversation is commercial, contractual, or sensitive.
* Attends client demos led by the relevant department lead and takes over when the conversation turns commercial.
* Keeps the company’s CRM up to date across their accounts and leads, logging contacts, deals, interactions, decisions, and commitments.

**New Business \& Lead Intake**

* Serves as intake for new inbound leads, owning the initial contact and qualifying fit against the agency's services, capacity, and ideal client profile.
* Leads pre\-sale discovery, surfacing the prospect's goals, constraints, timelines, budget range, and decision\-making process before any scoping begins.
* Translates discovery findings into a clear internal brief that the project team can scope and estimate, and that the Proposal \& Business Development Manager can use to build the proposal.
* Keeps deals moving toward a decision in HubSpot, maintaining stage, source, value, and next steps to keep pipeline reporting accurate, and follows up with clients on proposals awaiting a decision.
* Attends pipeline review meetings, bringing the status of open proposals and prospective work across their accounts.
* Watches pipeline trends worth acting on across their accounts, including where leads come from, which types convert, and where they stall, and brings what they learn to the pipeline review.
* Contributes account context, references, and client results to the proposal asset library, so the Proposal \& Business Development Manager and anyone pursuing new work can draw on them.

**Proposals, Contracts \& Commercial Agreements**

* Initiates proposals for new work on their accounts, briefing the Proposal \& Business Development Manager, who drafts and produces them; contributes client context, budget details, and commercial constraints throughout, and reviews the finished proposal before it reaches the client.
* Delivers and pitches proposals to the client, owning the commercial conversation through to a decision.
* Works with the Project Manager and department leads on scoping and estimating proposed work.
* Reviews the estimate before it reaches the client to assess whether the price aligns with what the client will approve and the margin the account needs, and raises concerns with the Project Manager and department leads, who own the accuracy of the underlying effort.
* Prepares contracts, statements of work, and renewal agreements using Company\-approved templates, ensuring every agreement is consistent and executed before work begins.
* Tracks outstanding contracts and upcoming retainer expirations, following up in time to renew, renegotiate, or wind down deliberately rather than letting a term lapse.
* Coordinates with leadership when modifications to standard contracts are required.
* Hands off signed work to the project team with a complete picture of what was sold, what was promised, and what was deliberately left out of scope.

**Financial Oversight \& Invoicing**

* Sends invoices and owns invoice accuracy across the account.
* Reviews project time entries monthly when preparing invoices, relying on the Project Manager to report where time exceeded expectations.
* Treats any reduction of invoiced hours below what was actually worked as a discount, following the approval path for discounts.
* Monitors payment status, coordinates with accounts receivable on delays, and follows up with clients directly.
* Reviews budget, scope, and hours burned on every active project monthly rather than waiting to be flagged, so pacing problems surface while there is still time to act.
* Confirms that what is being built matches what was sold, and decides how to handle drift by writing a change order, raising it with the client, or absorbing it with leadership\-approval.
* Owns the client\-facing side of budget conversations, working from their own review and the overage flags the Project Manager surfaces.
* Seeks approval from leadership before offering any discount, including writing off hours that were worked, absorbing out\-of\-scope effort, and reducing rates at renewal, and documents every discount and budget overage with the reasoning behind it.
